sources: ابن خلكان، وفيات الأعيان، ج3 ص271
الذهبي، سير أعلام النبلاء، ج18 ص420

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam al-Qadi al-Mawardi
ha.body: Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Mawardi ya rasu, alƙali, malamin fiƙihu na Shafi'iyya, shahararren masanin usulul fiƙhi kuma marubuci mai fasaha. Ya bar manyan littattafai, daga cikinsu akwai 'al-Hawi al-Kabir', 'A'lam al-Nubuwwa' da tafsirinsa. Ya kasance alƙali mai adalci, malamin fiƙihu gwani kuma marubuci mai fasaha, kuma ya bar gadon ilimi mai yawa.

sources: الذهبي، سير أعلام النبلاء، ج21 ص166
ابن خلكان، وفيات الأعيان، ج3 ص295

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam al-Hafiz Abd al-Ghani al-Maqdisi
ha.body: Imam Abd al-Ghani ibn Abd al-Wahid al-Maqdisi ya rasu, babban hafizin hadisi, malamin fiƙihu na Hanbaliyya kuma malami nagari. An san shi da yawan haddar hadisai da ilimomin addini. Ya rubuta littattafai masu amfani a kan hadisi da fiƙihu, kuma ya kasance mafaka ga ɗaliban ilimi a zamaninsa.

sources: ابن الأثير الكامل في التاريخ
المقريزي السلوك لمعرفة دول الملوك

ha.title: Cin Akka da yaƙi da ƙarshen kasancewar 'Yan Salibiyya a gaɓar tekun Sham
ha.body: Sultan al-Ashraf Khalil ibn Qalawun ya ci birnin Akka da yaƙi, sansani na ƙarshe na 'Yan Salibiyya a Sham. Wannan nasara ta kawo ƙarshen kasancewar sojojin 'Yan Salibiyya a Sham har abada bayan ƙarnuka biyu na yaƙe-yaƙe.

sources: الذهبي سير أعلام النبلاء
ابن خلكان وفيات الأعيان

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam al-Tirmidhi
ha.body: Abu Isa Muhammad ibn Isa al-Tirmidhi, marubucin al-Jami, ya rasu a Tirmidh a shekara ta 279 BH. Ya kasance cikin manyan malaman hadisi da marubutan littattafan Sunan.

sources: المؤرخون العثمانيون (تاريخ ابن الأثير والمقريزي)
الموسوعات التاريخية الحديثة

ha.title: Cin Kostantiniyya da yaƙi a hannun Sultan Muhammad al-Fatih (Mehmed)
ha.body: Sultan na Daular Usmaniyya Mehmed mai nasara (Muhammad al-Fatih) ya ci Kostantiniyya da yaƙi, babban birnin Daular Rumawa, bayan kewaye da ya ɗauki kwanaki 53. Wannan ya kawo ƙarshen daular Rumawa da ta daɗe shekara dubu, kuma babbar nasara ce ta Musulunci.

sources: الموسوعة السعودية الرسمية
موقع وزارة الشؤون الإسلامية السعودية

ha.title: Shelanta haɗewar Saudiyya
ha.body: Sarki Abdulaziz ibn Abd al-Rahman Al Saud ya shelanta haɗewar Masarautar Saudiyya ƙarƙashin tuta ɗaya bayan dogon lokaci na nasarori a jere. Sabon zamani na kwanciyar hankali da gine-gine ya fara.

sources: المقريزي خطط المقريزية
الذهبي تاريخ الإسلام

ha.title: Fara gina Masallacin al-Azhar a Alƙahira
ha.body: Kwamanda Jawhar al-Siqilli, bisa umarnin Halifa na Fatimiyawa al-Mu'izz li-Din Allah, ya fara gina Masallacin al-Azhar a birnin Alƙahira, wanda ya kafa ba da daɗewa ba. Daga baya al-Azhar ya zama ɗaya daga cikin manyan cibiyoyin ilimin Musulunci a tsawon tarihi.

sources: الذهبي سير أعلام النبلاء
ابن خلكان وفيات الأعيان

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj
ha.body: Abu al-Husain Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj ya rasu, marubucin Sahih Muslim, ɗaya daga cikin littattafai mafi inganci bayan al-Bukhari. Ya kasance cikin manyan malaman hadisi.

sources: الطبري تاريخ الرسل والملوك
ابن الأثير الكامل في التاريخ

ha.title: Yaƙin Raƙumi
ha.body: Yaƙin Raƙumi ya auku a Basra tsakanin rundunar Sarkin Muminai Ali ɗan Abu Talib da dakarun Uwar Muminai A'isha tare da al-Zubair da Talha. Yana cikin manyan fitintinu (fitan) na farko na cikin gida a Musulunci.

sources: الذهبي سير أعلام النبلاء تاريخ الإسلام
ابن خلكان وفيات الأعيان

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam Abu Hamid al-Ghazali
ha.body: Abu Hamid Muhammad ibn Muhammad al-Ghazali, Hujjar Musulunci (Hujjat al-Islam), ya rasu a Tus. Ya bar gado mai girma a fiƙihu, Sufanci da falsafar Musulunci. Shi ne marubucin shahararren littafin Ihya Ulum al-Din (Raya Ilimomin Addini).

sources: الطبري تاريخ الرسل والملوك
ابن سعد الطبقات الكبرى

ha.title: Rasuwar Halifa Abubakar as-Siddiq (Allah Ya yarda da shi)
ha.body: Halifan Musulmi na farko, Abubakar Abdullahi ibn Usman as-Siddiq, ya koma ga rahamar Allah Maɗaukaki bayan halifanci da ya ɗauki shekaru biyu, watanni uku da 'yan kwanaki. Ya bar gado mai cike da adalci da hikima.

sources: ابن كثير، البداية والنهاية، الجزء الثالث عشر، سنة 680، ترجمة تقي الدين بن رزين: (توفي ليلة الأحد ثالث رجب منها، ودفن بالمقطم) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/البداية_والنهاية/الجزء_الثالث_عشر/ثم_دخلت_سنة_ثمانين_وستمائة_من_الهجرة

الذهبي، العبر في خبر من غبر، الجزء الثالث، سنة 680، ترجمة ابن رزين: (ثم ولي قضاء القضاة فلم يأخذ عليه رزقا تدينا وورعا ... توفي في ثالث رجب) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/العبر_في_خبر_من_غبر/الجزء_الثالث

ha.title: Rasuwar Babban Alƙali Taqi al-Din Ibn Razin
ha.body: A Alƙahira a shekara ta 680 BH, Babban Alƙali Taqi al-Din Abu Abdullah Muhammad ibn al-Husain ibn Razin al-Hamawi al-Shafi'i ya rasu, ɗalibin Ibn al-Salah. Ya ba da fatawa a Dimashƙ yana matashi, ya koyar a al-Madrasa al-Shamiyya kuma ya ja sallah a Dar al-Hadith, sannan ya koma Masar, inda ya koyar a al-Zahiriyya kuma ya riƙe muƙamin Babban Alƙali. Al-Dhahabi ya ambata cewa, saboda tsoron Allah, bai karɓi albashi a kan aikin alƙalanci ba, kuma wasu imamai sun koyi fiƙihu a wurinsa. Ibn Kathir da al-Dhahabi sun ce ya rasu ne ranar 3 ga Rajab, kuma an binne shi a gangaren al-Muqattam.

sources: عبد الباسط الملطي، نيل الأمل في ذيل الدول، ج2 ص320: (وفي رجب في ثالثه مات الزركشي، الشيخ، العالم، بدر الدين محمد بن بهادر المنهاجي، الشافعي) — https://app.turath.io/book/17097?page=738
ابن قاضي شهبة، طبقات الشافعية 3/167 (بإحالة محقق فتح القريب المجيب، ج1 ص61): (وتوفي في ثالث رجب سنة أربع وتسعين وسبعمائة بالقاهرة) — https://app.turath.io/book/660?page=61

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam Badr al-Din al-Zarkashi, marubucin al-Burhan fi Ulum al-Quran
ha.body: A Alƙahira a shekara ta 794 BH, Imam Badr al-Din Muhammad ibn Bahadur ibn Abdullah al-Zarkashi ya rasu, malamin fiƙihu na Shafi'iyya, masanin usulul fiƙhi kuma malamin hadisi, ɗalibin Jamal al-Din al-Isnawi da Ibn Kathir. Ya haɗa koyarwa, ba da fatawa da rubutu, kuma ya bar littattafai da yawa a fannoni dabam-dabam, mafi shahara daga cikinsu su ne al-Burhan fi Ulum al-Quran, al-Bahr al-Muhit a kan usulul fiƙhi, al-Manthur fi al-Qawa'id, da al-Tanqih li-Alfaz al-Jami al-Sahih. Abd al-Basit al-Malati da Ibn Qadi Shuhba sun ambata cewa ya rasu ne ranar 3 ga Rajab.

sources: الذهبي، سير أعلام النبلاء، ج19 ص465 (ط الرسالة)، ترجمة الحريري: (توفي الحريري في سادس رجب سنة ست عشرة وخمس مائة بالبصرة) — https://app.turath.io/book/10906?page=12161
الصفدي، الوافي بالوفيات، ج24 ص98: (توفي في سادس شهر رجب سنة ست عشرة [وخمسمائة]) — https://app.turath.io/book/6677?page=6468
السبكي، طبقات الشافعية الكبرى، ج7 ص269: (توفي في يوم الاثنين ثامن رجب سنة ست عشرة وخمسمائة) — https://app.turath.io/book/6739?page=2584

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Hariri, marubucin al-Maqamat, a Basra
ha.body: A Basra a shekara ta 516 BH, masanin adabi Abu Muhammad al-Qasim ibn Ali al-Hariri ya rasu, marubucin Maqamat hamsin, waɗanda suka zama cikin shahararrun ayyukan rubutun zube na fasaha a harshen Larabci, kuma malamai sun riƙa yaɗa su ta hanyar sharhi da haddacewa tsawon ƙarnuka. Ya kuma rubuta Mulhat al-I'rab a kan nahawu da Durrat al-Ghawwas fi Awham al-Khawass. Al-Dhahabi da al-Safadi sun ambata cewa ya rasu ne ranar 6 ga Rajab, yayin da al-Sam'ani da Taj al-Din al-Subki suka ruwaito cewa ranar Litinin 8 ga Rajab na wannan shekarar ne, yana da kimanin shekara saba'in.

sources: الطبري، تاريخ الرسل والملوك، الجزء العاشر، سنة 287: (ولسبع خلون من رجب من هذه السنة توفيت ابنة خمارويه بن أحمد بن طولون، زوجة المعتضد) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/تاريخ_الطبري/الجزء_العاشر

ابن كثير، البداية والنهاية، الجزء الحادي عشر، سنة 287، نقلًا عن ابن الجوزي: (قال ابن الجوزي: لسبع خلون من رجب منها، ودفنت داخل القصر بالرصافة) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/البداية_والنهاية/الجزء_الحادي_عشر/ثم_دخلت_سنة_سبع_وثمانين_ومائتين

ha.title: Rasuwar Qatr al-Nada 'yar Khumarawayh, matar Halifa al-Mu'tadid
ha.body: A watan Rajab na shekara ta 287 BH, Qatr al-Nada 'yar Khumarawayh ibn Ahmad ibn Tulun, Amirin Masar, ta rasu a Bagadaza. Ita ce matar Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Mu'tadid Billah, budurwa da aka siffanta da hankali da kyau. Aurenta yana cikin shahararrun abubuwan da suka faru a zamaninta: an aike ta daga Masar zuwa Bagadaza da kayan ɗaki masu tarin yawa da suka zama karin magana a littattafan tarihi, kuma auren ya zama alamar sulhu tsakanin daular Tuluniyya da halifancin Abbasiyawa. Al-Tabari da Ibn al-Jawzi sun ambata cewa ta rasu ne ranar 7 ga Rajab kuma an binne ta a fadar al-Rusafa.

sources: أبو العرب التميمي، طبقات علماء إفريقية، ج1 ص102: (توفي يوم الثلاثاء لسبعة أيام مضت من رجب سنة أربعين ومائتين) — https://app.turath.io/book/13079?page=97
أبو بكر المالكي، رياض النفوس، ج1 ص347: (رجب لسبعة أيام مضت منه قبل صلاة الظهر سنة أربعين ومائتين) — https://app.turath.io/book/148883?page=379
ابن حجر، لسان الميزان، الجزء الثالث، نقلًا عن ابن يونس: (ومات لسبع خلون من رجب سنة أربعين ومائتين وهو ابن ثمانين سنة) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/لسان_الميزان/الجزء_الثالث
القاضي عياض، ترتيب المدارك، ج4 ص85 (ط المغربية): يذكر القولين لثلاث خلون ولسبع خلون من رجب — https://app.turath.io/book/31215?page=938

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam Sahnun, marubucin al-Mudawwana, a Ƙairawan
ha.body: A Ƙairawan a shekara ta 240 BH, Imam Abu Sa'id Abd al-Salam ibn Sa'id al-Tanukhi, wanda aka fi sani da Sahnun, ya rasu, malamin fiƙihu na Maghrib kuma alƙalin Ifriqiya, wanda ta hannunsa mazhabar Imam Malik ta yaɗu a Maghrib. Ya yi tafiya zuwa Masar ya yi karatu a wurin Ibn al-Qasim da Ashhab, sannan ya tattara al-Mudawwana, wadda ta zama babbar madogarar Malikiyya. A alƙalancinsa an san shi da tsoron Allah da tsayin daka da kuma ƙin karɓar albashi a kan aikin alƙalanci. Abu al-Arab al-Tamimi, Abu Bakr al-Maliki da Ibn Yunus sun ambata cewa ya rasu ne ranar Talata 7 ga Rajab, yayin da al-Qadi Iyad ya ruwaito wani ra'ayi cewa ranar 3 ne.

sources: ابن كثير، البداية والنهاية، الجزء الرابع عشر، سنة 705: (وفي يوم الاثنين ثامن رجب حضر القضاة والعلماء، وفيهم الشيخ تقي الدين بن تيمية عند نائب السلطنة بالقصر) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/البداية_والنهاية/الجزء_الرابع_عشر/ثم_دخلت_سنة_خمس_وسبعمائة

ابن عبد الهادي، العقود الدرية من مناقب شيخ الإسلام ابن تيمية: (وذلك يوم الاثنين ثامن رجب من سنة خمس وسبعمائة طلب القضاة والفقهاء وطلب الشيخ تقي الدين إلى القصر) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/العقود_الدرية_من_مناقب_شيخ_الإسلام_أحمد_بن_تيمية/7
ابن تيمية، مجموع الفتاوى، المجلد الثالث: (وذلك يوم الاثنين ثامن رجب المبارك عام خمس وسبعمائة)

ha.title: Zaman muhawarar Ibn Taymiyya a kan al-Aqida al-Wasitiyya a Dimashƙ
ha.body: A watan Rajab na shekara ta 705 BH, wakilin Sultan a Dimashƙ ya kira zama a fada wanda alƙalai da malaman fiƙihu suka halarta, kuma aka kira Shaikhul Islam Taqi al-Din Ibn Taymiyya don a tambaye shi game da aƙidarsa. Ya kawo risalarsa da aka sani da al-Aqida al-Wasitiyya, aka karanta ta kuma aka tattauna mas'alolinta a zama fiye da ɗaya. Ibn Kathir da Ibn Abd al-Hadi sun ce wannan zama ya kasance ranar Litinin 8 ga Rajab, kuma Ibn Taymiyya da kansa ya rubuta labarinsa. Ana ƙirga waɗannan muhawarori cikin shahararrun abubuwan da suka faru a rayuwarsa ta ilimi, kuma madogarai sun adana bayanansu da tattaunawar da ta gudana tsakanin malamai.

sources: الذهبي، تذكرة الحفاظ، الطبقة الثانية عشرة، ترجمة الماسرجسي: (مولده سنة ثمانٍ وتسعين ومائتين، وتوفي في تاسع رجب سنة خمس وستين وثلاثمائة) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/تذكرة_الحفاظ/الطبقة_الثانية_عشرة
السيوطي، طبقات الحفاظ، ترجمة الماسرجسي: (ولد سنة ثمان وتسعين ومائتين ومات في تاسع رجب سنة خمس وستين وثلاثمائة) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/طبقات_الحفاظ

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Hafiz al-Masarjisi, marubucin Musnad mafi girma mai sharhi
ha.body: A Naisabur a shekara ta 365 BH, hafizin hadisi Abu Ali al-Husain ibn Muhammad al-Masarjisi ya rasu, ɗaya daga cikin manyan malaman hadisi na Khurasan. Ya yi tafiye-tafiye kuma ya ji hadisi daga kakansa, Ibn Khuzayma da Abu al-Abbas al-Sarraj. Ya tattara babban Musnad ingantacce tare da nazarin illoli ɓoyayyu ('ilal) a kusan juzu'i dubu ɗaya da ɗari uku, wanda al-Hakim ya ce ba a taɓa tattara Musnad mafi girma da shi a Musulunci ba. Ya tattara hadisan al-Zuhri ta hanyar da babu wanda ya yi kafin shi, kuma ya tattara ƙarin littattafai (mustakhraj) a kan Sahihan al-Bukhari da Muslim. Al-Dhahabi da al-Suyuti sun ambata cewa ya rasu ne ranar 9 ga Rajab.

sources: ابن كثير، البداية والنهاية، الجزء الثالث عشر، سنة 680، وقعة حمص: (لما كان يوم الخميس رابع عشر رجب التقى الجمعان وتواجه الخصمان عند طلوع الشمس) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/البداية_والنهاية/الجزء_الثالث_عشر/ثم_دخلت_سنة_ثمانين_وستمائة_من_الهجرة

الذهبي، العبر في خبر من غبر، الجزء الثالث، سنة 680: (وفي يوم الخميس رابع عشر رجب كانت وقعة حمص. أقبل منكوتمر بن هولاوو بجيوش أخيه أبغا) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/العبر_في_خبر_من_غبر/الجزء_الثالث

ha.title: Yaƙin Himsa na Biyu da nasarar Mamluka a kan Mangolawa
ha.body: A watan Rajab na shekara ta 680 BH, rundunar Mangolawa ƙarƙashin Mengu-Timur ɗan Hulagu ta nufi Sham da yawa mai girma. Sultan al-Mansur Qalawun ya fita ya tare su da rundunonin Masar da Sham, kuma ɓangarorin biyu suka haɗu kusa da Himsa ranar Alhamis 14 ga Rajab. Faɗa ya yi zafi har aka karya Mangolawa suka janye daga Sham. Wannan yana cikin yaƙe-yaƙe mafi muhimmanci da suka kare Sham, shekaru ashirin bayan Ayn Jalut, kuma Ibn Kathir da al-Dhahabi sun ce ya auku ne a wannan rana.

sources: ابن الأثير، أسد الغابة، ترجمة معاوية بن أبي سفيان: (وتوفي معاوية النصف من رجب سنة ستين) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/أسد_الغابة_(ط._الوهبية)/حرف_الميم/باب_الميم_والعين/معاوية

ابن كثير، البداية والنهاية، الجزء الثامن، ترجمة معاوية: (فقال جماعة: ليلة الخميس للنصف من رجب سنة ستين. وقيل: ليلة الخميس لثمان بقين من رجب سنة ستين) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/البداية_والنهاية/الجزء_الثامن
الطبري، تاريخ الرسل والملوك، الجزء الخامس، سنة 60: يذكر القولين (للنصف من رجب) و(يوم الخميس لثمانٍ بقين من رجب)

ha.title: Rasuwar Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan (Allah Ya yarda da su) a Dimashƙ
ha.body: A watan Rajab na shekara ta 60 BH, Sahabi Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan (Allah Ya yarda da su) ya rasu a Dimashƙ, ɗaya daga cikin marubutan Wahayi kuma wanda ya kafa daular Umayyawa, bayan kusan shekara ashirin yana halifa da kuma shekara ashirin kafin haka yana gwamnan Sham. A zamaninsa yaƙe-yaƙen buɗe ƙasashe sun faɗaɗa a Arewacin Afirka da ƙasashen Rumawa, kuma ya kafa babbar rundunar sojin ruwa ta farko ta Musulunci tun yana gwamnan Sham. Masana tarihi sun saɓa a kan ranar rasuwarsa: Ibn al-Athir da wasu sun ambata cewa a tsakiyar Rajab ne, yayin da Ibn Ishaq da wasu suka ruwaito cewa kwana takwas ne kafin ƙarshen watan, kuma Ibn Kathir ya kawo dukkan ra'ayoyin.

sources: الطبري، تاريخ الرسل والملوك، الجزء التاسع، حوادث سنة 256: (خلع المهتدي، وتوفي يوم الخميس لاثنتي عشرة ليلة بقيت من رجب) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/تاريخ_الطبري/الجزء_التاسع
ابن كثير، البداية والنهاية، الجزء الحادي عشر، سنة 256: (وذلك يوم الخميس لثنتي عشرة ليلة بقيت من رجب) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/البداية_والنهاية/الجزء_الحادي_عشر/ثم_دخلت_سنة_ست_وخمسين_ومائتين

ha.title: Rasuwar Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Muhtadi Billah
ha.body: A watan Rajab na shekara ta 256 BH, Halifa na Abbasiyawa Muhammad ibn al-Wathiq, mai laƙabin al-Muhtadi Billah, ya rasu a Samarra bayan da shugabannin rundunar Turkawa suka tuɓe shi sakamakon saɓani da su; halifancinsa bai cika shekara ɗaya ba. An san al-Muhtadi a cikin halifofin Abbasiyawa da zuhudu, tsoron Allah, riƙo da adalci da yawan ibada, har wasu masana tarihi suka kwatanta shi da Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz. Sanannen ra'ayi a wurin al-Tabari da Ibn Kathir shi ne ya rasu ranar Alhamis saura dare goma sha biyu Rajab ya ƙare, kuma Ibn Kathir ya kawo wata riwaya da ta sanya rasuwarsa kwana biyu kafin haka.

sources: الذهبي، العبر في خبر من غبر، الجزء الثالث، سنة 635، ترجمة الكامل: (مرض بقلعة دمشق بالسعال والإسهال نيفا وعشرين ليلة ... فمات في الحادي والعشرين من رجب) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/العبر_في_خبر_من_غبر/الجزء_الثالث

ha.title: Rasuwar Sultan al-Kamil al-Ayyubi, mai 'yanto Dimyat
ha.body: A watan Rajab na shekara ta 635 BH, Sultan al-Malik al-Kamil Nasir al-Din Muhammad ibn al-Adil al-Ayyubi, mai mulkin Masar, ya rasu a Fadar Dimashƙ bayan gajeriyar rashin lafiya, bayan ya karɓi Dimashƙ watanni biyu kafin rasuwarsa. Ya mulki Masar kusan shekara arba'in, da farko a matsayin wakilin mahaifinsa sannan a matsayin sultan. An san shi da girmama malamai da zama tare da su, kuma ya shahara da jajircewarsa a kan Yaƙin Salibiyya na Biyar har ya ƙwato Dimyat bayan dogon kewaye. Al-Dhahabi ya ambata cewa ya rasu ne ranar 21 ga Rajab, yayin da Ibn Kathir ya sanya ta a daren Alhamis 22 ga wata.

sources: الطبري، تاريخ الرسل والملوك، الجزء الخامس، سنة 60: (وكان مخرج الحسين من المدينة إلى مكة يوم الأحد لليلتين بقيتا من رجب سنة ستين) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/تاريخ_الطبري/الجزء_الخامس

ha.title: Al-Husain ibn Ali (Allah Ya yarda da su) ya bar Madina zuwa Makka
ha.body: A ƙarshen Rajab na shekara ta 60 BH, al-Husain ibn Ali (Allah Ya yarda da su) ya bar Madina yana nufin Makka tare da iyalansa, bayan an nemi ya yi mubaya'a ga Yazid ibn Mu'awiya kuma ya ƙi. Al-Tabari da Ibn Kathir sun ambata cewa ya tashi ranar Lahadi saura dare biyu Rajab ya ƙare, kuma ya shiga Makka a daren Juma'a 3 ga Sha'aban, ya zauna a can sauran watan Sha'aban, Ramadan, Shawwal da Zul Ka'ada. Wannan tafiya ita ce farkon tattakin da ya ƙare da masifar Karbala a watan Muharram na shekara mai zuwa.

ha.title: Mubaya'a ga al-Muhtadi Billah a matsayin halifa a Samarra
ha.body: A ƙarshen Rajab na shekara ta 255 BH, Muhammad ibn al-Wathiq ya karɓi mubaya'a a matsayin halifa a Samarra kuma aka ba shi laƙabin al-Muhtadi Billah, bayan al-Mu'tazz ya sauka daga mulki a gaban alƙalai da shaidu. Al-Muhtadi yana cikin halifofin Abbasiyawa mafiya zuhudu da ibada; ya yi ƙoƙarin tabbatar da adalci, ya zauna don sauraron ƙorafe-ƙorafe kuma ya rage kashe kuɗin fada, amma halifancinsa bai kai shekara ɗaya ba. Madogarai sun yarda cewa an yi masa mubaya'a ranar Laraba saura dare ɗaya Rajab ya ƙare.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Hafiz Ali ibn al-Mufaddal al-Maqdisi a Alƙahira
ha.body: A farkon Sha'aban na shekara ta 611 BH, hafizin hadisi Sharaf al-Din Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn al-Mufaddal al-Maqdisi, daga baya al-Iskandarani, ya rasu a Alƙahira, ɗaya daga cikin manyan malaman hadisi na Masar a zamanin Ayyubiyawa. Ya yi karatu a wurin al-Hafiz Abu Tahir al-Silafi a Iskandariyya kuma ya yi mataimakin alƙali a can, sannan ya koma Alƙahira ya koyar a makarantar al-Sahib Ibn Shukr. Daga cikin shahararrun ɗalibansa akwai al-Hafiz Zaki al-Din al-Mundhiri, marubucin al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib, don haka ya kasance muhimmin mahaɗi wajen isar da ilimin hadisi tsakanin zuriyoyi biyu na malaman Masar. An binne shi a gangaren al-Muqattam.

ha.title: Al-Husain ibn Ali (Allah Ya yarda da su) ya shiga Makka
ha.body: A daren Juma'a 3 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 60 BH, al-Husain ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (Allah Ya yarda da su) ya shiga Makka daga Madina, bayan ya bar ta a ƙarshen Rajab sakamakon rasuwar Mu'awiya (Allah Ya yarda da shi). Ya zauna a Makka sauran watan Sha'aban, Ramadan, Shawwal da Zul Ka'ada, mutane suna taruwa a kusa da shi masu ziyara kuma suna nemansa, har ya tashi zuwa Iraƙi a Ranar Tarwiya. Wannan zama a Makka babi ne mai muhimmanci na rayuwarsa (Allah Ya yarda da shi) a watanninsa na ƙarshe.

ha.title: Halifa al-Mustansir Billah ya naɗa al-Zahir Baibars a kan sarautar sultan
ha.body: Ranar Litinin 4 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 659 BH, an yi gagarumin biki a wajen Alƙahira cikin wata babbar rumfa, wanda Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Mustansir Billah, alƙalai, amirai da masu iko suka halarta. Halifa ya naɗa Sultan al-Zahir Baibars a kan mulkin ƙasashe, ya sanya masa baƙar rigar halifanci, kuma aka karanta wa mutane takardar naɗinsa. Wannan ya zo ne bayan an yi wa al-Mustansir mubaya'a a matsayin halifa a Alƙahira bayan faɗuwar Bagadaza a hannun Mangolawa. Wannan lamari ya sanar da farfaɗowar halifancin Abbasiyawa a Masar da ci gabansa a matsayin alamar haɗin kan Musulmi kusan ƙarni biyu da rabi.

ha.title: Haihuwar al-Husain ibn Ali (Allah Ya yarda da su)
ha.body: A ranar 5 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 4 BH, an haifi al-Husain ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (Allah Ya yarda da su) a Madina, jikan Annabi ﷺ kuma furen raihaninsa, mahaifiyarsa kuwa ita ce Fatima az-Zahra (Allah Ya yarda da ita). An haife shi kusan shekara ɗaya bayan ɗan'uwansa al-Hasan (Allah Ya yarda da shi), kuma Annabi ﷺ ya yi masa tahniki ya raɗa masa suna. Ya taso a gidan Annabta, ya ruwaito daga kakansa ﷺ da iyayensa, kuma ya shahara da ibada, karimci da jarumta. Wannan kwanan wata shi ne abin da al-Zubair ibn Bakkar da wasu suka ruwaito, kuma wasu masana tarihi suna da wasu ra'ayoyi a kan ranar haihuwarsa.

ha.title: Rasuwar Ibn al-Najjar, masanin tarihin Bagadaza
ha.body: A ranar 5 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 643 BH, hafizin hadisi Muhibb al-Din Abu Abdullah Muhammad ibn Mahmud Ibn al-Najjar al-Baghdadi ya rasu a Bagadaza, ɗaya daga cikin manyan masana tarihi na Gabas. Ya yi tafiye-tafiye da yawa don neman ilimi zuwa Sham, Masar, Hijaz, Isfahan da Khurasan, kuma ya tattara 'Dhayl Tarikh Baghdad' a matsayin ci gaban littafin al-Khatib al-Baghdadi, tare da littattafai a kan masu ruwaya, tarihin Madina da falalar al-Shafi'i. Ya bar littattafansa a matsayin waƙafi (waqf) ga makarantar Nizamiyya domin ɗaliban ilimi bayansa su amfana da su.

ha.title: Rasuwar mai zuhudu Abu al-Qasim al-Qabbari a Iskandariyya
ha.body: A ranar 6 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 662 BH, Shaikh nagari Abu al-Qasim Muhammad ibn Mansur al-Qabbari ya rasu a Iskandariyya yana da shekara saba'in da biyar, ɗaya daga cikin shahararrun masu zuhudu na Masar a zamanin Mamluka. Ya zauna a wata ƙaramar gona da yake nomawa da hannunsa, yana rayuwa da 'ya'yan itatuwanta yana kuma ciyar da mutane daga cikinsu, kuma an san shi da tsananin tsoron Allah da kula wajen neman halal. Ya yi umarni da kyakkyawa da hani da mummuna kuma yana yi wa shugabanni wa'azi, suna kuma sauraronsa saboda zuhudunsa. Nasir al-Din Ibn al-Munayyir ya keɓe littafi na musamman kan tarihin rayuwarsa.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Hafiz Abu Khaythama Zuhair ibn Harb
ha.body: A daren Alhamis 7 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 234 BH, hafizin hadisi Abu Khaythama Zuhair ibn Harb al-Nasa'i ya rasu a Bagadaza, ɗaya daga cikin amintattun imaman hadisi. Ya ji hadisi daga Hushaym, Sufyan ibn Uyayna da tsararrakinsu, kuma al-Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud da wasu sun ruwaito daga gare shi; Imam Muslim ya ruwaito daga gare shi da yawa a cikin Sahihinsa. Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi ya siffanta shi da amintacce, abin dogaro, hafizi kuma mai tsantseni. Ya kasance tsaran Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal da Yahya ibn Ma'in a Bagadaza.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Hafiz Zain al-Din al-Iraqi
ha.body: A ranar 8 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 806 BH, hafizin hadisi Zain al-Din Abu al-Fadl Abd al-Rahim ibn al-Husain al-Iraqi ya rasu a Alƙahira, hafizin hadisi na zamaninsa kuma shaihin malaman hadisi a Masar. Ya farfaɗo da al'adar imla'in hadisi bayan ta lalace, kuma ya wallafa 'Alfiyyat al-Hadith' a kan ilimin mustalahul hadisi tare da sharhinta, da 'al-Mughni an Haml al-Asfar' wanda ya bibiyi hadisan Ihya. Daga cikin fitattun ɗalibansa akwai al-Hafiz Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani da al-Hafiz Nur al-Din al-Haythami, kuma ya yi tasiri mai zurfi a farfaɗowar ilimin hadisi a ƙarni na tara BH.

ha.title: Yaƙin Alarcos (al-Arak) a Andalus
ha.body: Ranar Laraba 9 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 591 BH, rundunar Muwahhidun ƙarƙashin jagorancin Halifa Abu Yusuf Ya'qub al-Mansur, tare da dakarun Andalus, ƙabilun Maghrib da masu sa kai, ta haɗu da rundunar Alfonso VIII, Sarkin Castile, a ƙagaran Alarcos kudu da Toledo. Yaƙin ya ƙare da babbar nasara ga Musulmi da janyewar Sarkin Castile. An ƙirga Alarcos a matsayin mafi girman nasarar Muwahhidun a Andalus; ta jinkirta ci gaban masarautun Sifen na arewa da kusan shekaru ashirin, kuma an yi amfani da ganimominta wajen gine-gine a Marrakesh da Rabat al-Fath.

ha.title: Rasuwar Babban Alƙali Abu Bakr al-Shami a Bagadaza
ha.body: Ranar Talata 10 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 488 BH, Babban Alƙali Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn al-Muzaffar ibn Bakran al-Hamawi al-Shafi'i, wanda aka fi sani da al-Shami, ya rasu a Bagadaza yana da shekara tamanin da takwas. Ya koyi fiƙihu a wurin al-Qadi Abu al-Tayyib al-Tabari kuma ya ci gaba da koyarwa a masallacinsa fiye da shekara hamsin, sannan Halifa al-Muqtadi ya naɗa shi Babban Alƙali. Ya shahara da matuƙar gaskiya da riƙon amana: bai karɓi albashi a kan aikin alƙalanci ba, bai karɓi kyaututtuka ba, kuma yana taka-tsantsan wajen karɓar shaidu, har aka ce idan mazhabar Shafi'iyya ta ɓace, zai iya rubuta ta daga haddarsa.

ha.title: Rasuwar Ibn Sayyid al-Nas, marubucin 'Uyun al-Athar'
ha.body: A ranar 11 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 734 BH, hafizin hadisi Fath al-Din Abu al-Fath Muhammad ibn Muhammad Ibn Sayyid al-Nas al-Ya'mari ya rasu farat ɗaya a Alƙahira; asalinsa ɗan Andalus ne kuma mazaunin Masar. Ya kasance malamin hadisi, masanin adabi kuma mawaƙi mai kyakkyawan rubutun hannu, kuma ya koyar da hadisi a makarantar al-Zahiriyya. Mafi shaharar aikinsa shi ne 'Uyun al-Athar fi Funun al-Maghazi wa al-Shama'il wa al-Siyar', ɗaya daga cikin littattafan Sirar Annabi na baya-bayan nan mafiya inganci da yaɗuwa. Ya fara sharhin Jami al-Tirmidhi wanda al-Hafiz al-Iraqi ya kammala bayansa.

ha.title: Rasuwar Ibn Malik, marubucin Alfiyya a kan nahawu
ha.body: Imam Jamal al-Din Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Malik al-Ta'i al-Jayyani, imamin nahawu da harshe a zamaninsa, ya rasu a Dimashƙ a shekara ta 672 BH. An haife shi a Jaén a Andalus, sannan ya yi tafiya zuwa Gabas, ya zauna a Halab sannan a Dimashƙ. Ya wallafa 'al-Alfiyya', wadda ta zama mafi shaharar waƙar koyarwa a kan nahawun Larabci kuma ta jawo sharhohi a jere, tare da 'al-Tashil' da 'al-Kafiya al-Shafiya'. Ra'ayin da aka fi sani shi ne ya rasu ranar 12 ga Sha'aban, yayin da Ibn Kathir ya ambata cewa a daren 12 ga Ramadan ne.

ha.title: Rasuwar Halifa al-Qa'im bi-Amr Allah da mubaya'a ga jikansa al-Muqtadi
ha.body: A daren Alhamis 13 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 467 BH, Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Qa'im bi-Amr Allah ya rasu a Bagadaza bayan halifanci na kusan shekara arba'in da huɗu da watanni takwas, ɗaya daga cikin halifancin Abbasiyawa mafiya tsawo. A wannan rana jikansa Abdullah ibn Muhammad ya karɓi mubaya'a a matsayin halifa, mai laƙabin al-Muqtadi bi-Amr Allah; yana da kimanin shekara ashirin. Ya zauna don karɓar mubaya'a a Fadar Halifanci, kuma wazirai, amirai da manyan mutane suka yi masa mubaya'a. An san mulkin al-Muqtadi da kwanciyar hankali da zaɓen alƙalai da wazirai daga cikin mutanen kirki.

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam Ishaq ibn Rahawayh
ha.body: A tsakiyar Sha'aban na shekara ta 238 BH, Imam Abu Ya'qub Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Hanzali, wanda aka fi sani da Ibn Rahawayh, malamin Khurasan a zamaninsa, ya rasu a Naisabur. Ya haɗa hadisi da fiƙihu, ya kasance tsaran Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal, kuma malamin al-Bukhari, Muslim da al-Tirmidhi. Ya shahara da haddar ban mamaki, domin ya yi imla'in 'Musnad' ɗinsa da tafsirinsa daga haddarsa. Ɗalibinsa al-Bukhari ya ce ya rasu ne a daren 15 ga Sha'aban, yayin da wasu suka ambata cewa ranar 14 ne.

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam al-Laith ibn Sa'd, malamin fiƙihu na Masar
ha.body: Ranar Juma'a a tsakiyar Sha'aban na shekara ta 175 BH, Imam Abu al-Harith al-Laith ibn Sa'd al-Fahmi ya rasu a Masar yana da shekara tamanin da ɗaya, malamin fiƙihu da hadisi na ƙasashen Masar. Ya ruwaito daga Ata, Nafi, al-Zuhri da wasu, kuma ya kasance imami, hujja kuma amintacce, har al-Shafi'i ya ce ya fi Malik ilimin fiƙihu, sai dai almajiransa ba su riƙe mazhabarsa ba. An san shi da karimci mai yawa da yawan sadaka ga masu ilimi, kuma wasiƙun fiƙihu tsakaninsa da Imam Malik suna cikin shahararrun misalan ladabin saɓani tsakanin malamai.

ha.title: Rasuwar Sultan al-Salih Ayyub a al-Mansura lokacin Yaƙin Salibiyya
ha.body: A daren 15 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 647 BH, Sultan na Ayyubiyawa al-Malik al-Salih Najm al-Din Ayyub ya rasu a al-Mansura yayin da yake tsaye yana fuskantar Yaƙin Salibiyya na Bakwai ƙarƙashin jagorancin Sarki Louis IX na Faransa, wanda ya ƙwace Dimyat. Matarsa Shajar al-Durr ta ɓoye labarin rasuwarsa kuma ta ci gaba da ba da umarni da sunansa har ɗansa Turan Shah ya iso daga Hisn Kayfa, domin a kiyaye haɗin kan rundunar. Bayan watanni yaƙin ya ƙare da cin nasara a kan 'Yan Salibiyya da kama sarkinsu a Fariskur, kuma rasuwar al-Salih ta zama share fagen tasowar daular Mamluka a Masar.

ha.title: Gobarar Babban Masallacin Umayyawa a Dimashƙ
ha.body: A daren 15 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 461 BH, wata babbar gobara ta tashi a Masallacin Umayyawa a Dimashƙ. Ta fara ne a gidan gwamna da aka sani da al-Khadra, wanda ke maƙwabtaka da masallacin ta ɓangaren alƙibla, sakamakon faɗa tsakanin sojoji masu jayayya, sannan ta bazu zuwa masallacin: rufinsa da aka shafe da zinariya ya rushe kuma shahararrun zane-zanensa na mosaic, waɗanda suka rufe bangonsa da hotunan birane, bishiyoyi da koguna, suka watse. An gina masallacin a zamanin al-Walid ibn Abd al-Malik kuma an ƙirga shi cikin abubuwan al'ajabi na gine-ginen Musulunci; yawancin adon asali ya ɓace a wannan gobara, kuma an sake gina shi a zamunna na baya.

ha.title: Rasuwar masanin fannoni da yawa Kamal al-Din Ibn Yunus al-Mawsili
ha.body: A tsakiyar Sha'aban na shekara ta 639 BH, babban malami Kamal al-Din Abu al-Fath Musa ibn Yunus ibn Man'a al-Mawsili, shaihin Shafi'iyya a birninsa, ya rasu a Mausil yana da kimanin shekara tamanin da takwas. Ya koyi fiƙihu a wurin mahaifinsa sannan a makarantar Nizamiyya a Bagadaza, kuma ya karanta nahawu a wurin Kamal al-Din al-Anbari. Sannan ya ƙware a ilimomin hankali da lissafi, har aka ce ya ƙware fannoni goma sha huɗu, kuma babu kamarsa a zamaninsa wajen ƙwarewa a lissafi. Ɗalibai sun yi tafiya zuwa gare shi daga ƙasashe da yawa, kuma ya koyar a makarantu da dama a Mausil.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Hafiz Ibn Nasir, malamin hadisi na Iraƙi
ha.body: A watan Sha'aban na shekara ta 550 BH, hafizin hadisi Abu al-Fadl Muhammad ibn Nasir al-Salami al-Baghdadi, malamin hadisi na Iraƙi a zamaninsa, ya rasu a Bagadaza yana da shekara tamanin da uku, kuma aka binne shi a Bab Harb. Da farko ya ƙware a harshe da adabi, sannan ya duƙufa ga hadisi, kuma ya koma daga mazhabar al-Shafi'i zuwa ta Ahmad. Ya kasance amintacce, abin dogaro kuma mai zuhudu; ya bar littattafansa waƙafi kuma bai bar komai ba sai tsofaffin tufafi da 'yan dinare. Daga cikin shahararrun ɗalibansa akwai Imam Ibn al-Jawzi. Ibn Kathir, da al-Dhahabi a cikin al-Ibar, sun ce ya rasu ne ranar 18 ga Sha'aban, yayin da al-Dhahabi ya ambata a cikin al-Tadhkira cewa ranar 12 ne.

ha.title: Tuɓe Halifa al-Ta'i li-Allah da mubaya'a ga al-Qadir Billah
ha.body: Ranar Asabar 19 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 381 BH, Sultan na Buyawa Baha al-Dawla ya tuɓe Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Ta'i li-Allah a Bagadaza. Bayan Halifa ya zauna a majalisarsa ta yau da kullum, aka ɗauke shi zuwa fadar sarauta kuma aka shaida saukarsa daga mulki. Aka rubuta wasiƙa zuwa ga ɗan baffansa Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Ishaq ibn al-Muqtadir, wanda ke zaune a al-Bata'ih; ya zo Bagadaza a watan Ramadan kuma ya ɗauki laƙabin al-Qadir Billah. Wannan lamari shaida ne na raunin halifanci a gaban sultanonin Buyawa, duk da haka al-Qadir ya yi mulki shekara arba'in da ɗaya kuma ya dawo da wani ɓangare na martabar halifanci.

ha.title: Haihuwar Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Wathiq Billah
ha.body: Ranar Litinin 20 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 196 BH, an haifi Harun ibn Muhammad al-Mu'tasim ibn Harun al-Rashid, wanda daga baya ya zama halifa na tara na Abbasiyawa da laƙabin al-Wathiq Billah; mahaifiyarsa baiwa ce 'yar Rumawa (ummu walad) mai suna Qaratis. Ya hau halifanci bisa naɗin mahaifinsa al-Mu'tasim a shekara ta 227 BH. Ya kasance masanin adabi mai son ilimi, waƙa da rera waƙoƙi, kuma a zamaninsa Mihna (fitinar tilastawa) kan aƙidar halittar Alƙur'ani ta ci gaba. Ya rasu a Samarra a shekara ta 232 BH kuma ɗan'uwansa al-Mutawakkil ya gaje shi, wanda ya kawo ƙarshen Mihna.

ha.title: Faɗuwar Baitul Maƙdis a hannun 'Yan Salibiyya
ha.body: A hantsin ranar Juma'a 23 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 492 BH, rundunar Yaƙin Salibiyya na Farko ta kutsa cikin Baitul Maƙdis (Bayt al-Maqdis) bayan kewaye da ya ɗauki kusan wata ɗaya da rabi. Birnin ya faɗi kuma aka kashe mazaunansa da yawa; yana cikin masifu mafiya muni da suka sami Musulmi a wannan zamani. Faɗuwarsa ta jawo firgici a duk duniyar Musulmi, kuma Masallacin al-Aqsa ya ci gaba da kasancewa ƙarƙashin ikon 'Yan Salibiyya kusan shekaru casa'in da ɗaya na Hijira, har Salahuddin al-Ayyubi ya ƙwato shi a shekara ta 583 BH.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Hafiz Mughultay, marubucin 'al-Zahr al-Basim'
ha.body: Ranar Talata 24 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 762 BH, hafizin hadisi Ala al-Din Mughultay ibn Qilij al-Bakjari al-Hanafi ya rasu a Alƙahira, ɗaya daga cikin manyan hafizan hadisi na Masar. Ya karɓi koyar da hadisi a makarantar al-Zahiriyya bayan Ibn Sayyid al-Nas, kuma yana da faɗin ilimi a kan nasaba da masu ruwaya. Littattafansa sun zarce ɗari, daga cikinsu akwai sharhin Sahih al-Bukhari, ƙari kan Tahdhib al-Kamal, da 'al-Zahr al-Basim fi Sirat Abi al-Qasim' ﷺ. Ya ci gaba da duƙufa ga karatu da rubutu har ƙarshen rayuwarsa.

ha.title: Nasarar al-Afshin a kan Sarkin Rumawa a Yaƙin Anzen
ha.body: Ranar Alhamis 25 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 223 BH, kwamanda al-Afshin, a shugabancin ɗaya daga cikin rundunonin Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Mu'tasim, ya haɗu da rundunar Sarkin Rumawa Theophilos a Anatoliya. Al-Afshin ya tsaya daram bayan wani zagaye mai wuya, kuma karawar ta ƙare da janyewar Sarkin da watsewar dakarunsa. Wannan karawa wani ɓangare ne na babban yaƙin al-Mu'tasim na mayar da martani ga harin Rumawa a kan Zibatra, kuma ta share hanya ga ci gaban rundunar Abbasiyawa zuwa Ankara sannan Amorium.

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam al-Suhayli, marubucin 'al-Rawd al-Unuf'
ha.body: A ranar 25 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 581 BH, Imam Abu al-Qasim Abd al-Rahman ibn Abdullah al-Suhayli al-Andalusi, masanin harshe, hadisi da Sirar Annabi, ya rasu a Marrakesh. An haife shi kusa da Malaga kuma ya rasa ganinsa yana da shekara goma sha bakwai, amma hakan bai hana shi ƙware a ilimomi ba. Mafi shaharar aikinsa shi ne 'al-Rawd al-Unuf', sharhin Sirar Annabi ta Ibn Hisham, ɗaya daga cikin sharhohin Sira mafiya daraja. Sultan na Muwahhidun ya kira shi zuwa Marrakesh ya girmama shi, kuma ya yi babban alƙali a can har rasuwarsa. Ibn Kathir ya ce ya rasu ne ranar 26 ga Sha'aban.

ha.title: Haihuwar Imam Ibn Daqiq al-Id
ha.body: Ranar Asabar 25 ga Sha'aban na shekara ta 625 BH, an haifi Taqi al-Din Abu al-Fath Muhammad ibn Ali al-Qushayri, wanda aka fi sani da Ibn Daqiq al-Id, a gaɓar tekun Yanbu a Hijaz yayin da iyayensa ke kan hanyarsu ta aikin Hajji. Ya taso a Kudancin Masar kuma ya ƙware a fiƙihun Malikiyya da na Shafi'iyya da kuma hadisi da usul, har aka ɗauke shi mujaddidi (mujaddid) na zamaninsa, kuma ya riƙe muƙamin Babban Alƙalin Masar. Daga cikin littattafansa akwai 'Ihkam al-Ahkam Sharh Umdat al-Ahkam' da 'al-Ilmam bi-Ahadith al-Ahkam'.

ha.title: Rasuwar Yazid ibn Abd al-Malik da hawan Hisham kan halifanci
ha.body: Saura kwana huɗu Sha'aban na shekara ta 105 BH ya ƙare, Halifa na Umayyawa Yazid ibn Abd al-Malik ya rasu bayan halifanci na kusan shekara huɗu kuma aka binne shi a al-Balqa a Sham. Ɗan'uwansa Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik ya karɓi mubaya'a a matsayin halifa bisa naɗin Yazid, yana da shekara talatin da huɗu. Halifancin Hisham ya ɗauki kusan shekara ashirin, ɗaya daga cikin mafiya tsawo na Umayyawa; an san shi da ƙarfin niyya, kyakkyawan tsari da tsararriyar gudanarwa, kuma zamaninsa ya ga faɗaɗa a kan iyakoki da gagarumin aikin gine-gine.

ha.title: Rasuwar malamin hadisi Abu Nu'aym al-Fadl ibn Dukayn
ha.body: A ranar ƙarshe ta Sha'aban na shekara ta 219 BH, hafizin hadisi Abu Nu'aym al-Fadl ibn Dukayn al-Mula'i ya rasu a Kufa, ɗaya daga cikin fitattun amintattun malaman hadisi kuma malamin al-Bukhari. Ya ji hadisi daga al-A'mash, Sufyan al-Thawri, Mis'ar da tsararrakinsu, kuma ya kasance abin al'ajabi a tsantseni, har Yahya al-Qattan ya ce bai damu da wanda ya saɓa masa ba idan Abu Nu'aym ya yarda da shi. Yawancin masana tarihi sun ambata cewa an binne shi a ranar ƙarshe ta Sha'aban, yayin da wasu suka ce ya rasu ne a watan Ramadan.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Imad al-Katib al-Asfahani, masanin tarihin Salahuddin
ha.body: A farkon Ramadan na shekara ta 597 BH, Imad al-Din Muhammad ibn Muhammad al-Katib al-Asfahani ya rasu a Dimashƙ, ɗaya daga cikin manyan jagororin rubutun diwani da adabi a ƙarni na shida BH. Ya yi wa Nuruddin Mahmud Zangi hidima sannan Salahuddin al-Ayyubi a diwanin rubuce-rubuce, kuma ya shaida nasarorin buɗe ƙasashe tare da shi, yana rubuta tarihinsu a 'al-Fath al-Qussi fi al-Fath al-Qudsi' game da ƙwato Baitul Maƙdis da kuma a 'al-Barq al-Shami', kuma ya tattara mawaƙan zamaninsa a 'Kharidat al-Qasr'. Ana ɗaukar littattafansa a matsayin madogara ta farko ga tarihin daular Ayyubiyawa. An binne shi a maƙabartar Sufaye.

ha.title: Yaƙin Shaqhab (Marj al-Suffar) da cin nasara a kan Tatarawa
ha.body: Ranar Asabar 2 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 702 BH, rundunar Mamluka ƙarƙashin jagorancin Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad ibn Qalawun, tare da Halifa na Abbasiyawa da dakarun Masar da Sham, ta haɗu da rundunar Tatarawa masu mamaya a Shaqhab kusa da Dimashƙ. Faɗa ya yi zafi tun daga La'asar har zuwa safiyar gobe; sannan aka ci Tatarawa suka watse a cikin jeji, kuma da yawa daga cikinsu suka nutse a Kogin Furat. Imam Ibn Taymiyya yana cikin waɗanda suka ƙarfafa mutane su tsaya daram, kuma Sultan ya shiga Dimashƙ ranar 5 ga Ramadan cikin farin ciki na gama gari.

ha.title: Al-Ma'mun ya naɗa Ali al-Rida magajin sarauta
ha.body: Ranar Talata 2 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 201 BH, Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Ma'mun, yana Marw, ya yi mubaya'ar gado ga Ali ibn Musa al-Kazim ibn Ja'far al-Sadiq a matsayin magajinsa, ya ba shi laƙabin 'al-Rida min Al Muhammad' (wanda aka yarda da shi daga iyalan Muhammad). Ya ba da umarni a bar baƙin launi, alamar Abbasiyawa, a koma kore, kuma ya rubuta haka zuwa dukkan yankuna. Masana tarihi sun ambata cewa al-Ma'mun ya duba cikin Abbasiyawa da zuriyar Ali bai sami wanda ya fi shi falala a ilimi da taƙawa ba. Wannan shawara ta jawo adawa daga wasu Abbasiyawa a Bagadaza, kuma Ali al-Rida ya rasu a Tus a shekara ta 203 BH kafin ya hau mulki.

ha.title: Rasuwar Fatima az-Zahra (Allah Ya yarda da ita)
ha.body: A daren Talata 3 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 11 BH, Fatima az-Zahra, 'yar Manzon Allah ﷺ (Allah Ya yarda da ita), ta rasu a Madina, 'yan watanni bayan rasuwar mahaifinta ﷺ, tana da kimanin shekara ashirin da tara. Ita ce shugabar matan 'yan Aljanna, mahaifiyar al-Hasan da al-Husain (Allah Ya yarda da su), kuma matar Ali ɗan Abu Talib (Allah Ya yarda da shi). Ita ce ƙaramar 'ya'yansa mata ﷺ kuma mafi soyuwa a gare shi daga cikinsu. An binne ta da daddare a al-Baqi, kuma masana tarihi suna da wasu ra'ayoyi game da tsawon lokacin da ta rayu bayan Annabi ﷺ.

ha.title: Rasuwar Abd al-Malik ibn Habib, malamin fiƙihu na Andalus
ha.body: A ranar 4 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 238 BH, Abd al-Malik ibn Habib al-Sulami, muftin Andalus kuma malaminta, ya rasu a Kordoba yana da kimanin shekara saba'in da huɗu. Ya yi tafiya zuwa Gabas ya yi karatu a wurin almajiran Imam Malik a Madina da Masar, sannan ya dawo ya yaɗa mazhabar Malikiyya a Andalus, har shugabancin ilimi a can ya koma gare shi bayan Yahya ibn Yahya al-Laythi. Daga cikin shahararrun littattafansa akwai 'al-Wadiha' a fiƙihu, ɗaya daga cikin littattafan tushe na farko na Malikiyya, kuma ya rubuta littafin tarihi. An kuma ambaci wasu shekaru na rasuwarsa.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Hafiz Abu Musa Abdullah ibn Abd al-Ghani al-Maqdisi
ha.body: Ranar Juma'a 5 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 629 BH, hafizin hadisi Abu Musa Abdullah, ɗan al-Hafiz Abd al-Ghani al-Maqdisi marubucin 'Umdat al-Ahkam', ya rasu a Dimashƙ. Ya yi tafiya don neman hadisi zuwa Isfahan, Naisabur, Mausil, Irbil da Harami biyu masu alfarma, ya koyi fiƙihu a wurin Shaikh Muwaffaq al-Din Ibn Qudama, kuma ya karanta Larabci a wurin Abu al-Baqa al-Ukbari. Ibn al-Hajib ya ce game da shi babu kamarsa a zamaninsa a haddace, ilimi da amana, kuma majalisunsa na wa'azi da hadisi a Dimashƙ sun shahara.

ha.title: Al-Mu'tasim ya kewaye Amorium
ha.body: Ranar Juma'a 6 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 223 BH, Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Mu'tasim Billah ya sauka da rundunarsa a kan birnin Amorium a tsakiyar Anatoliya, kwamandansa Ashinas ya riga shi zuwa can da kwana ɗaya; ya kewaye shi kuma ya fara kewayewar. Yaƙin martani ne ga harin Sarkin Rumawa a kan birnin Zibatra da abin da ya sami mutanensa. Kewayewar ta ƙare da cin birnin da yaƙi, kuma mawaƙi Abu Tammam ya dawwamar da wannan nasara a cikin shahararriyar waƙarsa mai ƙafiyar 'ba': 'Takobi ya fi littattafai gaskiyar labari.'

ha.title: Rasuwar Ibn Bashkuwal, masanin tarihin malaman Andalus
ha.body: A ranar 8 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 578 BH, hafizin hadisi Abu al-Qasim Khalaf ibn Abd al-Malik ibn Bashkuwal al-Ansari, malamin hadisi kuma masanin tarihin Andalus, ya rasu a Kordoba yana da shekara tamanin da huɗu. Ya ji daga manyan shaihunnan Kordoba da Seville, ya karɓi izini (ijaza) daga Abu Ali al-Sadafi, kuma ya yi mataimakin alƙali a wasu gundumomin Seville. Mafi shaharar littafinsa shi ne 'al-Sila', wanda ya ci gaba da shi da tarihin malaman Andalus na Ibn al-Faradi, kuma ya zama babbar madogara ga tarihin rayuwar malaman Andalus, tare da 'Ghawamid al-Asma al-Mubhama'.

sources: الطبري، تاريخ الرسل والملوك، الجزء الثالث (سنة 8) — https://ar.wikisource.org/wiki/تاريخ_الطبري/الجزء_الثالث

ha.title: Annabi ﷺ ya bar Madina zuwa Fatahin Makka
ha.body: A ranar 10 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 8 BH, Annabi ﷺ ya bar Madina tare da kusan mutane dubu goma daga Muhajirun, Ansar da ƙabilun Larabawa, yana nufin Makka bayan Kuraishawa sun karya Yarjejeniyar Hudaibiyya ta hanyar taimaka wa Banu Bakr a kan Khuza'a, abokan ƙawancen Musulmi. Ya naɗa Abu Ruhm Kulthum ibn Husain al-Ghifari (Allah Ya yarda da shi) a kan Madina, kuma ya ɓoye inda zai nufa don kada Kuraishawa su yi shiri. Ya yi tafiya yana azumi har ya isa al-Kadid, sannan ya sauka a Marr al-Zahran. Wannan shi ne share fagen Fatahin Makka, wanda ya auku bayan 'yan kwanaki.

ha.title: Kisan waziri Nizam al-Mulk, wanda ya kafa makarantun Nizamiyya
ha.body: A ranar 10 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 485 BH, aka kashe wazirin Saljuƙawa Nizam al-Mulk al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Tusi kusa da Nahavand yayin da yake tafiya tare da Sultan Malikshah zuwa Bagadaza; wani mutum daga Baɗiniyya ne ya caka masa wuƙa, wanda ya kusance shi a siffar mai ƙara mai ƙorafi. Nizam al-Mulk ya jagoranci al'amuran daular Saljuƙawa kusan shekara talatin kuma ya shahara da tallafa wa ilimi da ma'abotansa. Ya kafa makarantun Nizamiyya a Bagadaza, Naisabur da wasu wurare, waɗanda malamansu suka haɗa da Abu Ishaq al-Shirazi, al-Juwayni da al-Ghazali.

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam Ibn al-Jawzi a Bagadaza
ha.body: A watan Ramadan na shekara ta 597 BH, Imam Abu al-Faraj Abd al-Rahman ibn Ali Ibn al-Jawzi ya rasu a Bagadaza, mai wa'azin zamaninsa kuma ɗaya daga cikin marubuta mafiya yawan littattafai a tarihin Musulunci. Ya rubuta 'Zad al-Masir' a tafsiri, 'al-Muntazam' a tarihi, da 'Sayd al-Khatir' da wasu ayyuka a kan wa'azi da abubuwan da ke sanyaya zuciya. Halifofi, wazirai da dubun dubatar mutane sun halarci majalisun wa'azinsa. An ɗauki gawarsa a kan kawunan mutane kuma aka binne shi a Bab Harb kusa da Imam Ahmad. Al-Dhahabi da al-Suyuti sun ce ya rasu ne ranar Juma'a 13 ga wata, yayin da Ibn Kathir ya ambaci daren Juma'a 12 ga wata.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Hafiz Zaki al-Din al-Birzali al-Ishbili
ha.body: A daren 14 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 636 BH, hafizin hadisi Zaki al-Din Abu Abdullah Muhammad ibn Yusuf al-Birzali al-Ishbili, malamin hadisi mai yawan tafiye-tafiye na Sham, ya rasu a Hama. Ya zo daga Andalus don aikin Hajji a shekara ta 602 BH kuma ya duƙufa ga jin hadisi, yana tafiya zuwa Makka, Dimashƙ, Isfahan, Naisabur, Herat, Marw, Bagadaza da Mausil. Ya yi rubuce-rubuce da yawa, ya tattara 'al-Mu'jam al-Kabir' na malamansa, kuma ya tattara littattafai ga malamai da yawa. Ya zauna a Dimashƙ a matsayin limamin Masallacin Fulus, kuma an san shi da tawali'u da ba da littattafai kyauta ga ɗaliban ilimi.

ha.title: Rasuwar malamin fiƙihu Kamal al-Din Ibn al-Zamlakani
ha.body: Da asubahin ranar Laraba 16 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 727 BH, babban malami Kamal al-Din Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Abd al-Wahid al-Ansari, wanda aka fi sani da Ibn al-Zamlakani, ɗaya daga cikin manyan malaman fiƙihu na Shafi'iyya a Dimashƙ, ya rasu a garin Bilbays yana kan hanyarsa zuwa Alƙahira. An haife shi a shekara ta 667 BH, ya koyi fiƙihu a wurin Taj al-Din al-Fazari, ya shugabanci Dar al-Hadith al-Ashrafiyya kuma ya koyar a makarantu da dama, sannan ya zama alƙalin Halab; an kira shi don a naɗa shi alƙalin Dimashƙ, amma mutuwa ta riske shi. Yana da hankali mai sauri kuma gwani ne a muhawara, kuma ya rubuta littattafai a kan fiƙihu da usul. An binne shi a al-Qarafa kusa da kubbar al-Shafi'i.

ha.title: Rasuwar Uwar Muminai A'isha 'yar Abubakar (Allah Ya yarda da ita)
ha.body: A daren Talata 17 ga Ramadan, Uwar Muminai A'isha 'yar Abubakar as-Siddiq (Allah Ya yarda da su), matar Annabi ﷺ, ta rasu a Madina. Ita ce babbar malamar fiƙihu ta mata a cikin Al'umma kuma mafi yawan ruwayar hadisi a cikin matanta, kuma manyan Sahabbai sun kasance suna komawa gare ta a kan al'amuran ilimi. Ta nemi a binne ta da daddare a al-Baqi; Abu Huraira (Allah Ya yarda da shi) ya yi mata sallar jana'iza, kuma 'yan uwanta suka sauka cikin kabarinta. Sanannen ra'ayi shi ne ta rasu a shekara ta 58 BH, kuma an ce 57 BH, tana da kusan shekara sittin da bakwai.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Hafiz Abu Ali al-Kashshi al-Shirazi
ha.body: A ranar 18 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 405 BH, imami, hafizin hadisi kuma malamin fiƙihu Abu Ali al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Laith al-Kashshi, daga baya al-Shirazi, ya rasu a Shiraz, ɗaya daga cikin manyan imaman Farisa a hadisi da ƙira'o'in Alƙur'ani. Ya yi tafiya zuwa Bagadaza da Naisabur kuma ya ji daga Isma'il al-Saffar, Abu al-Abbas al-Asamm, Ibn al-Akhram da wasu. Al-Hakim al-Naysaburi ya yabe shi, yana siffanta shi da ci gaba a ilimin ƙira'o'i, hafizin hadisi kuma babban matafiyi. Yana da ɗalibai daga cikin hafizan hadisi waɗanda suka yaɗa ilminsa a Farisa, kuma Ibn al-Salah ya ambace shi a cikin Tabaqat al-Shafi'iyya.

ha.title: Rasuwar masanin tarihi Abu Shama al-Maqdisi
ha.body: A ranar 19 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 665 BH, Imam Shihab al-Din Abu al-Qasim Abd al-Rahman ibn Isma'il al-Maqdisi, wanda aka fi sani da Abu Shama, makarancin Alƙur'ani, masanin nahawu kuma masanin tarihi, ya rasu a Dimashƙ. Ya ƙware a ƙira'o'in Alƙur'ani kuma ya rubuta sharhin 'al-Shatibiyya' a kan ƙira'o'i bakwai, ya taƙaita 'Tarihin Dimashƙ' na Ibn Asakir, kuma ya shugabanci koyar da karatu a al-Turba al-Ashrafiyya da Dar al-Hadith al-Ashrafiyya. Mafi shaharar littafinsa shi ne 'al-Rawdatayn fi Akhbar al-Dawlatayn al-Nuriyya wa al-Salahiyya', babbar madogara ga tarihin Nuruddin da Salahuddin.

ha.title: Cin al-Badhdh da yaƙi, sansanin Babak al-Khurrami
ha.body: Ranar Juma'a 20 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 222 BH, kwamanda al-Afshin, shugaban rundunonin Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Mu'tasim, ya ci birnin al-Badhdh da yaƙi a Azarbaijan, ƙaƙƙarfan sansanin Babak al-Khurrami, wanda ya jagoranci tawaye mai faɗi da ya ɗauki kusan shekara ashirin wanda ya gajiyar da rundunonin halifanci. Nasarar ta zo ne bayan dogon kewaye da yaƙe-yaƙe masu zafi, kuma al-Mu'tasim ya ƙarfafa rundunar da kuɗi da mutane. Babak ya gudu bayan faɗuwar ƙagararsa kuma aka kama shi a wannan shekarar, ta haka aka kawo ƙarshen ɗaya daga cikin hargitsi mafiya haɗari na farkon zamanin Abbasiyawa.

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam Ibn Majah, marubucin al-Sunan
ha.body: A ranar 22 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 273 BH, Imam Abu Abdullah Muhammad ibn Yazid ibn Majah al-Qazwini ya rasu a Qazvin yana da shekara sittin da huɗu. Ya yi tafiya don neman hadisi zuwa Iraƙi, Hijaz, Sham da Masar, kuma ya tattara 'Sunan', wanda ya zama ɗaya daga cikin littattafai shida na hadisin Annabi, tare da Tafsiri da Tarihi. Abu Ya'la al-Khalili ya siffanta shi da babban malami amintacce, wanda aka yarda da shi kuma ake dogaro da shi a matsayin hujja. Ɗan'uwansa Abu Bakr ya yi masa sallar jana'iza, kuma 'yan'uwansa biyu da ɗansa suka ɗauki nauyin binne shi.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Hafiz Ibn Mardawayh al-Asbahani
ha.body: A ranar 24 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 410 BH, hafizin hadisi Abu Bakr Ahmad ibn Musa ibn Mardawayh, malamin hadisi, mai tafsiri kuma masanin tarihin Isfahan, ya rasu a Isfahan yana da kusan shekara casa'in. Ya ji hadisi a Isfahan da Iraƙi, kuma yana da zurfin fahimta game da masu ruwaya da ƙwarewa mai faɗi a wannan fanni. Ya tattara babban tafsiri bisa ruwayoyi, wanda masu tafsiri na baya kamar Ibn Kathir da al-Suyuti suka dogara da shi, da kuma 'al-Mustakhraj ala Sahih al-Bukhari' da 'Tarikh Asbahan'. Ana ɗaukarsa ɗaya daga cikin fitattun hafizan hadisi na ƙarni na huɗu da na biyar BH.

ha.title: Khalid ibn al-Walid (Allah Ya yarda da shi) ya rusa gunkin al-Uzza
ha.body: A ranar 25 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 8 BH, 'yan kwanaki bayan Fatahin Makka, Annabi ﷺ ya aiki Khalid ibn al-Walid (Allah Ya yarda da shi) zuwa Batn Nakhla tsakanin Makka da Ɗa'if, inda gidan al-Uzza yake, mafi girman gunkin Kuraishawa da Kinana. Ya rusa shi kuma ya dawo ya sanar da Annabi ﷺ. Rusa al-Uzza yana cikin rundunonin da Annabi ﷺ ya aika a waɗannan kwanaki don kawar da alamomin bautar gumaka a kewayen Makka, kamar rusa Suwa' da Manat, ta haka aka tsarkake Tsibirin Larabawa daga manyan alamomin shirka.

ha.title: Shelanta da'awar Abbasiyawa a Khurasan
ha.body: A daren Alhamis 25 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 129 BH, Abu Muslim al-Khurasani ya shelanta da'awar Abbasiyawa a fili a ƙauyen Safidhanj kusa da Marw. Ya ɗaga baƙaƙen tutoci biyu da Ibrahim al-Imam ya aiko masa, kuma shi da abokansa suka sa baƙaƙen tufafi, waɗanda suka zama alamar sabuwar daular. Ya iso Marw a farkon Ramadan na wannan shekarar, kuma mutane suka yi tururuwa zuwa gare shi daga ƙauyukan da ke kewaye. Wannan shelanta ta zama farkon juyin juya halin da ya kawo ƙarshen daular Umayyawa a Gabas kuma ya kafa halifancin Abbasiyawa a shekara ta 132 BH.

ha.title: Rasuwar malamin fiƙihu na Shafi'iyya Ibn Kajj al-Dinawari
ha.body: A daren 27 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 405 BH, al-Qadi Abu al-Qasim Yusuf ibn Ahmad ibn Kajj, ɗaya daga cikin manyan imaman Shafi'iyya kuma cikin masanan da ra'ayoyinsu ke da nauyi a cikin mazhabar (ashab al-wujuh), wata ƙungiyar 'yan fashi ('ayyarun) ta kashe shi a Dinawar a lokacin hargitsi bayan rasuwar amirinta Badr ibn Hasanawayh. Ya koyi fiƙihu a wurin Abu al-Husain Ibn al-Qattan kuma ya rubuta littattafai a kan mazhabar. Ya zama abin misali wajen haddar fiƙihun Shafi'iyya, har wasu suka fifita shi a kan shaihin Shafi'iyya, Abu Hamid al-Isfarayini, kuma an san shi da karimci da dukiya mai yawa.

ha.title: Rasuwar Amirin Murabitun Tashfin ibn Ali kusa da Wahran
ha.body: A daren 27 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 539 BH, Amir Tashfin ibn Ali ibn Yusuf ibn Tashfin, mai mulkin daular Murabitun, ya gamu da ajalinsa kusa da Wahran. Ya fita da daddare daga sansaninsa da aka kewaye don kai hari kan sansanin Muwahhidun ƙarƙashin Abd al-Mu'min ibn Ali, kuma a wani dare mai duhu da ruwan sama ya faɗo daga wani dutse mai tsawo da ke kallon teku. Ya shafe gajerun shekarun mulkinsa cikin yaƙe-yaƙe babu ƙaƙƙautawa da Muwahhidun, kuma da rasuwarsa rugujewar daular Murabitun, wadda ta mulki Maghrib da Andalus kusan shekara saba'in, ta yi sauri, har Marrakesh ta faɗa hannun Muwahhidun kusan shekara biyu bayan haka.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Hafiz Nur al-Din al-Haythami, marubucin 'Majma al-Zawa'id'
ha.body: A daren Talata 29 ga Ramadan na shekara ta 807 BH, hafizin hadisi Nur al-Din Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Abi Bakr al-Haythami ya rasu a Alƙahira, abokin al-Hafiz al-Iraqi, surukinsa kuma abokin tafiyarsa na kullum wajen jin hadisi da tafiye-tafiye. Ya shafe rayuwarsa yana tattara ƙarin hadisai (zawa'id) na littattafan hadisi bayan Littattafai Shida, ya tattara 'Majma al-Zawa'id wa Manba al-Fawa'id', inda ya haɗa ƙarin hadisan Musnad na Ahmad, al-Bazzar, Abu Ya'la da Mu'jaman al-Tabarani tare da hukunta isnadansu, da kuma 'Mawarid al-Zam'an ila Zawa'id Ibn Hibban'. Ibn Hajar ya siffanta shi da kyakkyawan hali da dawwama a kan sallar dare.

ha.title: Rasuwar Halifa al-Nasir li-Din Allah bayan halifancin Abbasiyawa mafi tsawo
ha.body: A ranar ƙarshe ta Ramadan na shekara ta 622 BH, Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Nasir li-Din Allah Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn al-Mustadi ya rasu a Bagadaza bayan halifanci na kusan shekara arba'in da bakwai, mulki mafi tsawo na kowane halifa na Abbasiyawa. A zamaninsa ya yi aiki don dawo da martabar halifanci da tasirinsa na siyasa a Iraƙi, kuma ya yi zamani ɗaya da Salahuddin al-Ayyubi da ƙwato Baitul Maƙdis. Shanyewar jiki ta same shi a kwanakinsa na ƙarshe, kuma bayansa ɗansa al-Zahir bi-Amr Allah ya karɓi mubaya'a.

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam Muwaffaq al-Din Ibn Qudama al-Maqdisi
ha.body: A ranar Idin Ƙaramar Sallah (Eid al-Fitr) ta shekara ta 620 BH, Imam Muwaffaq al-Din Abdullah ibn Ahmad ibn Qudama al-Maqdisi, ɗaya daga cikin manyan jagororin fiƙihun Hanbaliyya, ya rasu a Dimashƙ yana da kusan shekara tamanin. Ya taso a cikin iyali daga Baitul Maƙdis da ta yi hijira zuwa Dimashƙ, ya yi tafiya zuwa Bagadaza don neman ilimi, sannan ya dawo don koyarwa, ba da fatawa da rubutu. Daga cikin shahararrun littattafansa akwai 'al-Mughni' a fiƙihun kwatance, 'Rawdat al-Nazir' a usulul fiƙhi, da 'al-Umda', 'al-Muqni' da 'al-Kafi'. Babban taron jama'a ya halarci jana'izarsa, kuma aka binne shi a gangaren Dutsen Qasiyun. Littattafansa sun ci gaba da zama madogara a fiƙihu har zuwa yau.

ha.title: Rasuwar makaranci kuma mai tafsiri Abu Bakr al-Naqqash
ha.body: Ranar Talata 2 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 351 BH, Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Naqqash, shaihin makarantan Alƙur'ani a zamaninsa, ya rasu a Bagadaza yana da shekaru sama da tamanin. Ya yi tafiya don neman ƙira'o'i da hadisi zuwa Sham, Masar, al-Jazira da Khurasan, kuma mutane masu yawa sun karanta Alƙur'ani a wurinsa. Ya tattara babban tafsiri mai suna 'Shifa al-Sudur', da littattafai a kan ilimomin Alƙur'ani. Wasu malaman hadisi, kamar al-Daraqutni, sun soki tsantseninsa a ruwaya, amma matsayinsa a ƙira'o'in Alƙur'ani ya ci gaba da shahara. An ruwaito cewa yana ta maimaita wata aya ta Alƙur'ani yayin da yake mutuwa har ransa ya fita, kuma aka binne shi a gidansa a Bagadaza.

ha.title: Rasuwar masanin tarihi Taqi al-Din al-Fasi, masanin tarihin Makka
ha.body: A farkon Shawwal na shekara ta 832 BH, masanin tarihi kuma malamin hadisi Taqi al-Din Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Fasi, alƙalin Malikiyya na Makka, ya rasu a can. An haife shi kuma ya taso a Makka, ya yi tafiya don neman hadisi, kuma ya rubuta tarihohi mafiya faɗi na Birni Mai Alfarma, daga cikinsu akwai 'al-Iqd al-Thamin fi Tarikh al-Balad al-Amin' da 'Shifa al-Gharam bi-Akhbar al-Balad al-Haram', waɗanda suka zama madogara ga duk wanda ya rubuta game da Makka da fitattun mutanenta. Ɗalibinsa Ibn Fahd al-Makki ya ce ya rasu ne a daren 3 ga Shawwal, yayin da al-Suyuti ya ambata cewa ranar 2 ne.

ha.title: Rasuwar malamin hadisi na Kufa Ya'la ibn Ubayd al-Tanafisi
ha.body: Ranar Lahadi 5 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 209 BH, amintaccen malamin hadisi Abu Yusuf Ya'la ibn Ubayd al-Tanafisi ya rasu a Kufa yana da shekaru sama da casa'in, a zamanin halifancin al-Ma'mun. Ya ruwaito daga al-A'mash, Yahya ibn Sa'id al-Ansari da Isma'il ibn Abi Khalid, kuma marubutan Littattafai Shida sun ruwaito daga gare shi. Ya shahara da tsoron Allah da kyawawan halaye, har wasu daga cikin tsararrakinsa suka ce ba su taɓa ganin wanda ke neman Yardar Allah da iliminsa kamarsa ba. Shi da 'yan'uwansa sun fito daga gidan da aka sani a Kufa da ilimi da albarka.

ha.title: Rasuwar imamin harshen Larabci Taj al-Din al-Kindi
ha.body: A ranar 6 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 613 BH, Taj al-Din Abu al-Yumn Zayd ibn al-Hasan al-Kindi ya rasu a Dimashƙ yana da shekara casa'in da uku. Ya kasance imami a nahawu, harshe da ƙira'o'in Alƙur'ani; isnadansa sun yi ɗaukaka har mutane suke tafiya zuwa gare shi, kuma al-Malik al-Mu'azzam Isa al-Ayyubi ya yi karatu a wurinsa, yana saukowa daga fada don ya koya. Malamai da masana adabi sun yabe shi kuma mawaƙa sun yi masa ta'aziyya da waƙoƙi; an yi masa sallar jana'iza a Masallacin Umayyawa kuma aka binne shi a al-Salihiyya. Daga cikin ayyukansa na alheri akwai cewa ya bar ɗakin karatunsa mai daraja, fiye da mujalladi ɗari bakwai, waƙafi ga malamai da ɗaliban ilimi.

ha.title: Yaƙin Hamra al-Asad
ha.body: Washegarin Yaƙin Uhud, ranar Lahadi a watan Shawwal na shekara ta 3 BH, Annabi ﷺ ya umarci ladaninsa ya kira mutane su fita don bin sawun rundunar Kuraishawa, kuma kada wani ya fita tare da shi sai waɗanda suka halarci Uhud. Musulmi suka tashi duk da raunukansu har suka isa Hamra al-Asad, 'yan mil kaɗan daga Madina, kuma suka zauna a can kwanaki suna kunna wuta, don haka Abu Sufyan ya zaɓi komawa Makka. Ibn Sa'd ya ce ranar 8 ga Shawwal ne bisa ga lissafinsa na Uhud a ranar 7, yayin da Ibn Ishaq ya sanya shi ranar 16 domin ya lissafa Uhud a tsakiyar Shawwal.

ha.title: Rasuwar Tabi'i Imam Muhammad ibn Sirin
ha.body: A ranar 9 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 110 BH, Imam Muhammad ibn Sirin al-Ansari, ɗaya daga cikin manyan malaman Tabi'ai (Tabi'in), ya rasu a Basra, kusan kwana ɗari bayan rasuwar abokinsa al-Hasan al-Basri. Ya kasance malamin fiƙihu mai tsoron Allah, amintacce a ruwayar hadisi, kuma ya shahara da matuƙar kula a samun abinci da mu'amala, da kuma ƙwarewarsa a fassarar mafarki, har sunansa ya zama abin danganta da wannan fanni. Tsararrakinsa sun yabe shi da ilimi, tsoron Allah da girman hali, kuma an ƙirga shi cikin fitattun mutanen Basra a zamaninta na zinariya.

ha.title: Rasuwar Sultan mai adalci Nuruddin Mahmud Zangi
ha.body: A ranar 11 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 569 BH, Sultan Nuruddin Mahmud ibn Zangi ya rasu a Dimashƙ yana da shekara hamsin da takwas, bayan ya yi mulki kusan shekara ashirin da takwas. Ya haɗa Halab, Dimashƙ, Mausil da Masar ƙarƙashin tuta ɗaya, ya yaƙi 'Yan Salibiyya, kuma an san shi da adalci da zuhudu. Ya kafa Gidan Adalci (Dar al-Adl), makarantu da Asibitin Nuri (Bimaristan) a Dimashƙ, kuma ya ba da umarnin ƙera mimbarin da Salahuddin ya ɗauka daga baya zuwa Masallacin al-Aqsa. Manufofinsa sun yi tasiri mai girma wajen share hanyar 'yanto Baitul Maƙdis.

ha.title: Shahadar al-Hafiz Makki al-Rumayli, masanin tarihin Baitul Maƙdis
ha.body: A ranar 12 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 492 BH, aka kashe hafizin hadisi Abu al-Qasim Makki ibn Abd al-Salam al-Rumayli al-Maqdisi, bayan 'Yan Salibiyya sun kama shi fursuna lokacin da suka ƙwace Baitul Maƙdis a watan Sha'aban na wannan shekarar. Ya kasance malamin hadisi mai yawan tafiye-tafiye wanda ya ratsa Masar, Sham da Iraƙi, kuma malamin fiƙihu na Shafi'iyya wanda tambayoyin fatawa ke zuwa masa daga Masar, gaɓar teku da Dimashƙ, kuma ya fara rubuta tarihin Baitul Maƙdis. Wasu masana tarihi sun ambata cewa an kashe shi ne a ranar da Turawan Faranj suka shiga birnin a watan Sha'aban, kuma rayuwarsa ta ci gaba da zama shaida kan jarrabawar malamai a wannan lokaci.

ha.title: Haihuwar Imam Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Bukhari
ha.body: A ranar 13 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 194 BH, ranar Juma'a bayan sallah, an haifi Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Bukhari a Bukhara, wanda ya zama Sarkin Muminai a Hadisi. Ya taso maraya ƙarƙashin kulawar mahaifiyarsa, ya fara neman hadisi tun yana ƙarami, sannan ya yi tafiya zuwa Hijaz, Iraƙi, Sham da Masar. Ya tattara 'al-Jami al-Sahih', wanda Al'umma ta karɓe shi hannu bibbiyu kuma ta ɗauke shi littafi mafi inganci bayan Littafin Allah, tare da 'al-Tarikh al-Kabir' da 'al-Adab al-Mufrad'. Malaman hadisi sun rubuta kwanan watan haihuwarsa da tsantseni da ke nuna kulawarsu ga tarihin rayuwar imamansu.

ha.title: Yaƙin Banu Qaynuqa
ha.body: A tsakiyar Shawwal na shekara ta biyu bayan Hijira, kusan wata ɗaya bayan Yaƙin Badar, Annabi ﷺ ya yi tattaki a kan Yahudawan Banu Qaynuqa a Madina bayan sun karya alƙawarin da ke tsakaninsa da su. Suka ja da baya cikin ƙagaransu, kuma Musulmi suka kewaye su dare goma sha biyar har suka miƙa wuya bisa sharaɗin a kore su, suka bar Madina zuwa Adhri'at a Sham. Wannan ita ce karawa ta farko tsakanin Musulmi da Yahudawan Madina, kuma ta taimaka wajen ƙarfafa tsaron sabuwar daular. Al-Waqidi ya ambata cewa ranar Asabar ne, tsakiyar Shawwal.

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam Abu Dawud al-Sijistani, marubucin al-Sunan
ha.body: A tsakiyar Shawwal na shekara ta 275 BH, Imam Abu Dawud Sulayman ibn al-Ash'ath al-Sijistani ya rasu a Basra, marubucin 'Sunan', ɗaya daga cikin littattafai shida na hadisi. Ya yi tafiya don neman hadisi zuwa Khurasan, Iraƙi, Sham, Masar da Hijaz, kuma ya yi karatu a wurin Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal da wasu. A cikin Sunan ɗinsa ya tattara hadisan hukunce-hukuncen shari'a, yana zaɓar su daga ɗaruruwan dubbai, don haka littafinsa ya zama madogara ga malaman fiƙihu. An binne shi a Basra kusa da kabarin Sufyan al-Thawri, yana da shekara saba'in da uku.

ha.title: Rasuwar hafizin hadisi mai yawan tafiye-tafiye Abu Sa'd al-Malini
ha.body: Ranar Talata 17 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 412 BH, hafizin hadisi mai zuhudu Abu Sa'd Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Malini al-Harawi ya rasu a Masar, ɗaya daga cikin malaman hadisi masu yawan tafiye-tafiye daga cikin Sufaye. Ya ratsa Khurasan, Iraƙi, Hijaz, Sham da Masar, ya ji daga Ibn Adi, Abu al-Shaykh al-Asbahani da wasu, kuma ya yi rubutu da kwafi da yawa, har aka san shi da ingancin kwafinsa; ya kasance amintacce kuma mai tsantseni. Daga cikin littattafansa akwai 'al-Arba'in fi Shuyukh al-Sufiyya'. Ana ɗaukarsa misali na malaman da suka haɗa tafiya don neman hadisi da zuhudu.

ha.title: Haihuwar Sultan Nuruddin Mahmud Zangi a Halab
ha.body: Da fitowar rana ranar Lahadi 17 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 511 BH, an haifi Nuruddin Mahmud ibn Imad al-Din Zangi a Halab, wanda ya zama ɗaya daga cikin manyan sarakunan zamaninsa. Ya taso ƙarƙashin kulawar mahaifinsa, mai mulkin Halab da Mausil, sannan ya gaji mulkin Halab bayan an kashe mahaifinsa a shekara ta 541 BH. Ya haɗa Sham kuma ya haɗa Masar da ita, kuma ya yaƙi 'Yan Salibiyya. An san shi da adalci, zuhudu da kafa makarantu, gidajen hadisi da asibitoci, kuma ta manufofinsa ya share hanyar 'yanto Baitul Maƙdis a hannun Salahuddin. Shi ma ya rasu a watan Shawwal, a shekara ta 569 BH.

ha.title: Rasuwar malamin fiƙihu Abu Sa'd al-Mutawalli, marubucin 'Tatimmat al-Ibana'
ha.body: A daren Juma'a 18 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 478 BH, malamin fiƙihu na Shafi'iyya Abu Sa'd Abd al-Rahman ibn Ma'mun al-Mutawalli ya rasu a Bagadaza yana da kimanin shekara hamsin da biyu. Ya koyi fiƙihu a Marw, Marw al-Rudh da Bukhara, sannan ya koyar a makarantar Nizamiyya a Bagadaza bayan rasuwar Shaikh Abu Ishaq al-Shirazi. Daga cikin shahararrun littattafansa akwai 'Tatimmat al-Ibana', wanda ya cika da shi littafin malaminsa al-Furani, ya tattara a ciki mas'aloli da ba a cika samu ba da ra'ayoyin fiƙihu, har ya zama ɗaya daga cikin madogaran mazhabar Shafi'iyya. Ya kuma rubuta taƙaitaccen littafi a kan ilimin gado da wani littafi a kan tushen addini. An binne shi a maƙabartar Bab Abraz.

ha.title: Rasuwar Shaikh Abu Hamid al-Isfarayini, imamin Shafi'iyya a Bagadaza
ha.body: A daren Asabar saura dare goma sha ɗaya Shawwal na shekara ta 406 BH ya ƙare, Shaikh Abu Hamid Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Isfarayini, shaihin Shafi'iyya a Iraƙi a zamaninsa, ya rasu a Bagadaza. Ya zo Bagadaza yana matashi kuma ya koyi fiƙihu a can har shugabancin mazhabar ya koma gare shi; ɗaruruwan malaman fiƙihu sun halarci halƙarsa, kuma ya rubuta babban sharhi (ta'liqa) a kan 'Mukhtasar al-Muzani' wanda ya zama tushen hanyar Iraƙawa a cikin mazhabar. An yi masa sallar jana'iza a fili tare da babban taron jama'a, kuma aka binne shi a gidansa sannan daga baya aka mayar da shi. Malamai sun yabe shi da ilimi da addini.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Rabi ibn Sulayman al-Muradi, mai ruwayar littattafan al-Shafi'i
ha.body: A ranar 20 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 270 BH, al-Rabi ibn Sulayman al-Muradi ya rasu a Masar, ɗalibin Imam al-Shafi'i kuma mai ruwayar littattafansa, daga cikinsu akwai 'al-Umm' da 'al-Risala' a ruwayarsu ta Masar. Ya kasance ladani a Masallacin Amr ibn al-As a Fustat, kuma ya raka al-Shafi'i shekaru da dama har ya zama mafi amincin mutane wajen ruwayar littattafansa, har ɗaliban ilimi suke tafiya zuwa gare shi daga ƙasashe masu nisa don su ji su daga gare shi. An ambata cewa shi ne na farko da ya yi imla'in hadisi a Masallacin Ibn Tulun. Sakamakon ruwayarsa, littattafan al-Shafi'i waɗanda aka gina mazhabarsa a kansu sun iso gare mu.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Fayruzabadi, marubucin 'al-Qamus al-Muhit'
ha.body: A daren 20 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 817 BH, Majd al-Din Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Fayruzabadi ya rasu a birnin Zabid a Yaman, yana da kusan shekara casa'in. An haife shi a Kazerun a Farisa, kuma ya ratsa Iraƙi, Sham, Masar, Hijaz da Indiya a matsayin ɗalibi da malami, sannan ya zama babban alƙalin Yaman. Ya shahara da ƙamus ɗinsa 'al-Qamus al-Muhit', wanda ya zama ɗaya daga cikin ƙamus ɗin Larabci mafiya shahara da amfani, kuma al-Zabidi ya rubuta sharhinsa 'Taj al-Arus'. An ƙirga shi cikin imaman harshe waɗanda suka yi wa Larabci hidima ta hanyar tattarawa da gyarawa.

ha.title: Rasuwar Harmala ibn Yahya al-Tujibi, abokin Imam al-Shafi'i
ha.body: A daren Alhamis saura kwana tara Shawwal na shekara ta 243 BH ya ƙare, malamin fiƙihu kuma malamin hadisi Harmala ibn Yahya al-Tujibi ya rasu a Masar, ɗaya daga cikin ɗaliban Imam al-Shafi'i mafiya kusanci a Masar kuma mai ruwayar maganganunsa da littattafansa da yawa a cikin sabuwar mazhabarsa. Ya kuma ji da yawa daga Abdullah ibn Wahb, har aka ce yana da dukkan hadisan Ibn Wahb, kuma Imam Muslim ya ruwaito daga gare shi a cikin Sahihinsa, haka ma Ibn Majah, Abu Zur'a da Abu Hatim. Ana ɗaukarsa ɗaya daga cikin ginshiƙan isar da fiƙihun Shafi'iyya a zuriyarsa ta farko a Masar.

ha.title: Rasuwar Amir Sayf al-Din al-Mashtub, kwamandan dakarun Akka
ha.body: A ranar 23 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 588 BH, Amir Sayf al-Din Ali ibn Ahmad al-Mashtub al-Hakkari ya rasu a Baitul Maƙdis, ɗaya daga cikin manyan amiran Sultan Salahuddin al-Ayyubi kuma shugaban Kurdawa a rundunarsa. Ya raka Asad al-Din Shirkuh a yaƙe-yaƙensa a Masar, sannan ya zama wakilin Salahuddin a kan Akka lokacin dogon kewayenta; da ta faɗa hannun 'Yan Salibiyya aka kama shi kuma ya fanshi kansa da kuɗi masu yawa, kuma Salahuddin ya girmama shi ya naɗa shi a kan Nablus. Madogarai sun saɓa a kan ranar rasuwarsa, tsakanin 22 da 26 ga Shawwal.

ha.title: Rasuwar malamin fiƙihu Asbagh ibn al-Faraj, malamin Malikiyya a Masar
ha.body: Ranar Lahadi saura kwana huɗu Shawwal na shekara ta 225 BH ya ƙare, malamin fiƙihu Asbagh ibn al-Faraj, ɗan Umayyawa ta hanyar wala'i (maula), ya rasu a Masar, ɗaya daga cikin manyan imaman mazhabar Malikiyya a Masar. Ya koyi fiƙihu a wurin Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, Abdullah ibn Wahb da Ashhab, kuma Yahya ibn Ma'in ya ce game da shi yana cikin halittun Allah mafiya sanin ra'ayin Malik, yana sanin sa mas'ala bayan mas'ala. Al-Bukhari ya ruwaito daga gare shi a cikin Sahihinsa; ya kasance madogarar fatawa a zamaninsa, malamai da yawa na baya sun dogara da ra'ayoyinsa a littattafan Malikiyya, kuma ya kasance marubuci ga Ibn Wahb.

ha.title: Rasuwar babban malami Ibn al-Hajib, marubucin 'al-Kafiya' da 'al-Shafiya'
ha.body: A hantsin ranar Alhamis 26 ga Shawwal na shekara ta 646 BH, babban malami Jamal al-Din Abu Amr Usman ibn Umar, wanda aka fi sani da Ibn al-Hajib, malamin fiƙihu na Malikiyya, masanin nahawu, masanin usulul fiƙhi kuma makarancin Alƙur'ani, ya rasu a Iskandariyya. An haife shi a Esna a Kudancin Masar kuma ya yi karatu a Alƙahira da Dimashƙ. Daga cikin shahararrun littattafansa akwai 'al-Kafiya' a nahawu, 'al-Shafiya' a ilimin sarf, 'Mukhtasar al-Muntaha' a usulul fiƙhi, da 'Jami al-Ummahat' a fiƙihun Malikiyya; ɗalibai sun yi amfani da su tsawon ƙarnuka kuma an rubuta sharhohi da yawa a kansu a Gabas da Yamma.

ha.title: Kisan Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Muqtadir Billah
ha.body: A ƙarshen Shawwal na shekara ta 320 BH, aka kashe Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Muqtadir Billah Ja'far ibn al-Mu'tadid a wajen Bagadaza a Bab al-Shammasiyya, a faɗa da dakarun kwamanda Mu'nis al-Khadim, wanda ya yi tattaki daga Mausil yana neman albashin sojoji. Al-Muqtadir ya hau halifanci yana yaro ɗan shekara goma sha uku, kuma halifancinsa ya ɗauki kusan shekara ashirin da biyar, cikin halifancin Abbasiyawa mafiya tsawo, amma ya ga raunin ikon tsakiya da mamayar kwamandoji da wazirai. Bayansa ɗan'uwansa Muhammad ya karɓi mubaya'a kuma aka ba shi laƙabin al-Qahir Billah.

ha.title: Rasuwar imamin masu tafsiri Muhammad ibn Jarir al-Tabari
ha.body: A yammacin ranar Lahadi, kwana biyu kafin ƙarshen Shawwal na shekara ta 310 BH, Imam Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Jarir al-Tabari ya rasu a Bagadaza yana da shekaru sama da tamanin. An haife shi a Amol a Tabaristan, ya zagaya ƙasashe don neman ilimi, sannan ya zauna a Bagadaza yana rubutu da koyarwa. Ya bar manyan ayyuka biyu masu faɗi: 'Jami al-Bayan an Ta'wil Ay al-Quran', wanda ya zama tushen tafsiri bisa ruwayoyi, da 'Tarikh al-Rusul wa al-Muluk', wanda ya zama babbar madogara ga masana tarihi bayansa. An binne shi a gidansa a Bagadaza, kuma an san shi da zuhudu, wadatar zuci da faɗin ilimi.

ha.title: Rasuwar Halifa al-Mustadi da mubaya'a ga al-Nasir li-Din Allah
ha.body: A ranar ƙarshe ta Shawwal na shekara ta 575 BH, Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Mustadi bi-Amr Allah ya rasu a Bagadaza, kuma ɗansa Abu al-Abbas Ahmad, mai laƙabin al-Nasir li-Din Allah, ya karɓi mubaya'a. Zamanin al-Mustadi ya ga dawowar huɗubar Juma'a da sunan halifancin Abbasiyawa a Masar a hannun Salahuddin bayan ƙarshen daular Fatimiyawa, kuma Ibn al-Jawzi ya siffanta shi da adali kuma mai karimci. Halifancin al-Nasir ya ɗauki shekara arba'in da bakwai, wanda ya sa ya zama halifa na Abbasiyawa mafi daɗewa a mulki. Wasu masana tarihi sun ambata cewa mubaya'ar gama gari ga al-Nasir ta kasance a farkon Zul Ka'ada.

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam Abu Ja'far al-Tahawi
ha.body: A farkon Zul Ka'ada na shekara ta 321 BH, Imam Abu Ja'far Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Tahawi ya rasu a Masar yana da shekaru sama da tamanin. Shi ɗan 'yar'uwar Imam al-Muzani ne; da farko ya karanta mazhabar al-Shafi'i, sannan ya koma mazhabar Abu Hanifa har shugabancin Hanafiyya a Masar ya koma gare shi. Ya haɗa fiƙihu da hadisi, kuma ya rubuta 'Sharh Ma'ani al-Athar', 'Sharh Mushkil al-Athar', da littattafai a kan takardun shari'a, saɓanin malamai da hukunce-hukuncen Alƙur'ani. Ana danganta masa 'al-Aqida al-Tahawiyya', taƙaitacciyar aƙidar da Ahlus Sunna suka karɓe ta hannu bibbiyu.

ha.title: Rasuwar Imamin Imamai Ibn Khuzayma, marubucin 'al-Sahih'
ha.body: A farkon Zul Ka'ada na shekara ta 311 BH, Imam Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn Khuzayma al-Sulami, mai laƙabin Imamin Imamai, ya rasu a Naisabur yana da shekara tamanin da tara. Ya yi tafiya zuwa Iraƙi, Sham, al-Jazira da Masar, ya koyi fiƙihu a wurin al-Muzani da wasu, kuma al-Bukhari da Muslim sun ruwaito daga gare shi a wajen Sahihansu. Ya tattara 'al-Sahih', wanda aka sani da Sahih Ibn Khuzayma, da 'Kitab al-Tawhid', kuma ya zama abin misali wajen haddar isnadai da matani da kuma zuhudunsa da karimcinsa. Al-Dhahabi ya ce ya rasu ne ranar 2 ga Zul Ka'ada, yana kawo Tarihin Naisabur, yayin da Ibn al-Jawzi ya ambata cewa ranar 8 ne.

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam al-Hafiz Shams al-Din al-Dhahabi, masanin tarihin Musulunci
ha.body: A daren Litinin 3 ga Zul Ka'ada na shekara ta 748 BH, hafizin hadisi Shams al-Din Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Usman al-Dhahabi ya rasu a Dimashƙ, bayan ya rasa ganinsa a ƙarshen rayuwarsa. Ya kasance malamin hadisi, masanin tarihi kuma mai nazarin masu ruwaya, kuma ya bar littattafan da suka zama babbar madogara ga waɗanda suka zo bayansa, mafi shahara daga cikinsu su ne 'Tarikh al-Islam', 'Siyar A'lam al-Nubala', 'Mizan al-I'tidal' da 'Tadhkirat al-Huffaz'. An yi masa sallar jana'iza a Masallacin Umayyawa kuma aka binne shi a maƙabartar Bab al-Saghir. Ɗalibinsa Ibn Kathir ya ce da shi ne jerin shaihunnai da gwanayen hadisi ya ƙare.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Hafiz Abd al-Azim al-Mundhiri, marubucin 'al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib'
ha.body: A ranar 4 ga Zul Ka'ada na shekara ta 656 BH, hafizin hadisi Zaki al-Din Abd al-Azim ibn Abd al-Qawi al-Mundhiri ya rasu a Alƙahira, shaihin Dar al-Hadith al-Kamiliyya a Masar. Ya kasance imami a hadisi, illolinsa ɓoyayyu da sanin masu ruwayarsa, malamin fiƙihu na Shafi'iyya mai ƙwarewa a harshe, kuma hafizan hadisi da dama sun yaye a hannunsa, daga cikinsu akwai Sharaf al-Din al-Dimyati. Daga cikin shahararrun littattafansa akwai 'al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib', wanda har yanzu ake amfani da shi a masallatai da gidaje, tare da taƙaitawarsa ta Sahih Muslim da Sunan Abi Dawud. An binne shi a al-Qarafa.

ha.title: Rasuwar Sultan al-Mansur Qalawun, wanda ya gina Asibitin Mansuri
ha.body: A ranar 6 ga Zul Ka'ada na shekara ta 689 BH, Sultan na Mamluka al-Mansur Qalawun al-Salihi ya rasu a sansaninsa a wajen Alƙahira yayin da yake shirin tattaki zuwa Akka, babban sansani na ƙarshe na 'Yan Salibiyya a gaɓar tekun Sham. Ya yi mulki kusan shekara goma sha biyu, ya ci Mangolawa a Himsa, kuma ya ci Tarabulus ta Sham da yaƙi a shekara ta 688 BH. Ya bar a Bayn al-Qasrayn a Alƙahira wani babban gini da ya ƙunshi makaranta, gidan hadisi da asibiti (bimaristan) wanda ya ci gaba da jinyar marasa lafiya tsawon ƙarnuka. Ɗansa al-Ashraf Khalil ya gaje shi, wanda ya kammala cin Akka da yaƙi bayan 'yan watanni.

ha.title: Rasuwar Imam al-Daraqutni, Sarkin Muminai a Hadisi
ha.body: A watan Zul Ka'ada na shekara ta 385 BH, Imam Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Umar al-Daraqutni ya rasu a Bagadaza yana da shekara saba'in da tara kuma aka binne shi a maƙabartar Ma'ruf al-Karkhi. Ya haɗa sanin hadisi da illolinsa ɓoyayyu da ƙira'o'in Alƙur'ani, nahawu, fiƙihu da adabi, har al-Hakim ya ce bai taɓa ganin kamarsa ba. Daga cikin shahararrun littattafansa akwai 'al-Sunan', 'al-Ilal' da 'al-Ilzamat wa al-Tatabbu' a kan Sahihai biyu. Al-Dhahabi da al-Suyuti sun ce ya rasu ne ranar 8 ga Zul Ka'ada, yayin da Ibn Kathir ya ambata cewa ranar Talata 7 ga wata ne.

ha.title: Rasuwar Shaikhul Islam Siraj al-Din al-Bulqini
ha.body: Ranar Juma'a 10 ga Zul Ka'ada na shekara ta 805 BH, Shaikhul Islam Siraj al-Din Umar ibn Raslan al-Bulqini ya rasu a Alƙahira, malamin fiƙihu na Shafi'iyya a zamaninsa kuma ɗaya daga cikin manyan mujtahidai a cikin mazhabarsu. Ya riƙe muƙamin muftin Dar al-Adl kuma ya yi alƙalin Dimashƙ na wani lokaci, ya koyar a manyan makarantun Alƙahira kamar al-Khashshabiyya da al-Zahiriyya, kuma ya koyar da tafsiri a Masallacin Ibn Tulun. Daga cikin littattafansa akwai 'Mahasin al-Istilah' a kan ilimomin hadisi da sharhohin al-Bukhari da al-Tirmidhi. Yana da 'ya'ya maza malamai, daga cikinsu akwai Jalal al-Din al-Bulqini, wanda ya gaje shi a matsayinsa.

ha.title: Buɗe makarantar Nizamiyya a Bagadaza
ha.body: Ranar Asabar 10 ga Zul Ka'ada na shekara ta 459 BH, makarantar Nizamiyya wadda wazirin Saljuƙawa Nizam al-Mulk ya kafa ta buɗe a Bagadaza, kusan shekara biyu bayan fara gina ta. Shaikh Abu Ishaq al-Shirazi ne ya kamata ya koyar a can, amma da ya jinkirta zuwa, aka naɗa Abu Nasr Ibn al-Sabbagh, marubucin 'al-Shamil', a madadinsa; sannan Abu Ishaq ya koma gare ta bayan kusan kwana ashirin. Nizamiyya ta zama abin koyi ga jerin makarantu da suka bazu a biranen Gabas, kuma fitattun mutane kamar Abu Hamid al-Ghazali sun koyar a can daga baya.

ha.title: Rasuwar Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Muktafi Billah
ha.body: A daren Lahadi 12 ga Zul Ka'ada na shekara ta 295 BH, Halifa na Abbasiyawa al-Muktafi Billah Ali ibn al-Mu'tadid ya rasu a Bagadaza yana da shekara talatin da biyu, bayan halifanci na kusan shekara shida. Ya gaji daula mai kwanciyar hankali daga mahaifinsa; a zamaninsa halifanci ya ƙwato Masar da Sham daga daular Tuluniyya a shekara ta 292 BH, kuma rundunoninsa sun yaƙi Ƙaramiɗa a Sham. Da rashin lafiyarsa ta tsananta ya naɗa ɗan'uwansa Ja'far a matsayin magaji, wanda ya karɓi mubaya'a bayansa da laƙabin al-Muqtadir Billah, yaro ɗan shekara goma sha uku, mafi ƙanƙanta da ya hau halifanci har zuwa wannan lokaci.

ha.title: Rasuwar malamin hadisi kuma malamin fiƙihu Abu al-Tahir ibn al-Sarh al-Misri
ha.body: Ranar Litinin 14 ga Zul Ka'ada, malamin fiƙihu kuma malamin hadisi Abu al-Tahir Ahmad ibn Amr ibn al-Sarh, ɗan Umayyawa ta hanyar wala'i (maula), ya rasu a Masar, ɗaya daga cikin malaman Imam Muslim, Abu Dawud, al-Nasa'i da Ibn Majah. Ya ruwaito da yawa daga Abdullah ibn Wahb, da kuma daga Imam al-Shafi'i, Sufyan ibn Uyayna da al-Walid ibn Muslim, kuma masanin tarihin Masar Ibn Yunus ya siffanta shi da malamin fiƙihu daga cikin mutanen kirki kuma amintacce. Al-Suyuti ya ce ya rasu ne a shekara ta 250 BH, yayin da Ibn Hajar ya ambaci 255 BH a cikin Tahdhib al-Tahdhib, duk da cewa sun yarda a kan rana da wata.

ha.title: Rasuwar Sultan al-Muzaffar Qutuz, gwarzon Ayn Jalut
ha.body: A ranar 16 ga Zul Ka'ada na shekara ta 658 BH, aka kashe Sultan na Mamluka al-Muzaffar Sayf al-Din Qutuz yana kan hanyarsa ta komawa Masar, tsakanin al-Ghazali da al-Salihiyya, a hannun wasu amirai, ƙasa da watanni biyu bayan babbar nasararsa a kan Mangolawa a Ayn Jalut. Ya hau sarautar sultan kusan shekara ɗaya kafin haka don haɗa kan sahu a kan barazanar Mangolawa, kuma Ibn Kathir ya siffanta shi da mutumin kirki, mai yawan sallar jam'i kuma abin ƙauna ga mutane. Al-Zahir Baibars ya hau sarautar sultan bayansa.

ha.title: Rasuwar Sitt al-Sham 'yar Ayyub, wadda ta kafa makarantun Shamiyya biyu
ha.body: Ranar Juma'a 16 ga Zul Ka'ada na shekara ta 616 BH, Sitt al-Sham 'yar Najm al-Din Ayyub, 'yar'uwar Sultan Salahuddin al-Ayyubi, ta rasu a Dimashƙ. Tana cikin mata mafiya sadaka da kyautatawa a zamaninta; kowace shekara tana sa a shirya abubuwan sha da magunguna a gidanta da darajarsu ta kai dubban dinare kuma ta raba su ga mabuƙata. Ta bar waƙafin makarantu biyu da aka sani da al-Shamiyya al-Juwwaniyya a cikin Dimashƙ da al-Shamiyya al-Barraniyya a wajenta, waɗanda suka zama cikin makarantun Shafi'iyya mafiya muhimmanci a birnin. Ta rasu a gidanta, wanda ta mayar makaranta, sannan aka mayar da ita kabarinta a al-Shamiyya al-Barraniyya.

ha.title: Al-Zahir Baibars ya hau sarautar sultan ta Masar da Sham
ha.body: A ranar 17 ga Zul Ka'ada na shekara ta 658 BH, Amir Rukn al-Din Baibars al-Bunduqdari ya hau sarautar sultan ta Mamluka a Masar da Sham kuma aka ba shi laƙabin al-Malik al-Zahir. Ya kasance ɗaya daga cikin Mamlukan al-Malik al-Salih Ayyub, kuma ya yi yaƙi a Yaƙin al-Mansura a kan Yaƙin Salibiyya na Bakwai, sannan a Yaƙin Ayn Jalut. Mulkinsa ya ɗauki kusan shekara goma sha bakwai, inda ya farfaɗo da halifancin Abbasiyawa a Alƙahira, ya ci ƙagarai da yawa na 'Yan Salibiyya da yaƙi kamar Caesarea, Jaffa, Antakiya da Krak des Chevaliers (Hisn al-Akrad), ya kori Mangolawa, kuma ya kafa tsarin gidan waya mai sauri tsakanin Alƙahira da Dimashƙ.

ha.title: Rasuwar al-Zubair ibn Bakkar, alƙalin Makka kuma masanin nasabar Kuraishawa
ha.body: A daren Lahadi saura kwana tara Zul Ka'ada na shekara ta 256 BH ya ƙare, al-Qadi Abu Abdullah al-Zubair ibn Bakkar, daga zuriyar Sahabi al-Zubair ibn al-Awwam (Allah Ya yarda da shi), ya rasu a Makka yana da shekara tamanin da huɗu. Ya yi alƙalin Makka, kuma ya zo Bagadaza inda ya ruwaito hadisi; yana cikin mutane mafiya sanin nasabar Larabawa da labaran al'ummomin da suka gabata. Daga cikin shahararrun littattafansa akwai 'Jamharat Nasab Quraysh wa Akhbariha', wanda ya zama tushe ga waɗanda suka zo bayansa a ilimin nasaba, da 'al-Akhbar al-Muwaffaqiyyat'. Al-Daraqutni da al-Khatib al-Baghdadi sun tabbatar da amincinsa, kuma Ibn Majah ya ruwaito daga gare shi.
